articleTitle: Real Time Classification for Robotic Arm Control Based Electromyographic Signal
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Bioengineering developments have enabled in increasingly advanced prosthetic devices for amputees and paraplegic people. With the advancement of technology for control and the enhancement of people's living conditions, the demand for high-quality prostheses among disabled persons has grown significantly. Real-time characterization of bio signals, such as electromyographic (EMG) data acquired from intact muscles, is required for control of such devices. This study provides a control of robotic arm depend on the surface EMG of the human arm. Our system's unique characteristics include physiologically informed forearm muscle selection for EMG signal recording, simple feature extraction from EMG signals and clever hand gesture selection for easy classification. The Arduino Uno is used to operate the servo motors that move our model, and it handles the EMG signals that are produced at varying levels of recurrence and concentration. EMG signals from the forearm surface of eight healthy individuals were collected during the experiments. The outcomes of the experiment show that the system gesture real - time tracking rate is achieved up to 90%, and it responds fast, laying the groundwork for future artificial limb control.

articleTitle: Position Feedback Control of Lagrangian Robotic Systems via an Affine PD-Based Control Law. Part 2: Improved Results
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper is mainly concerned with the position control problem of Lagrangian robotic systems using the LMI approach. To solve such problem, we consider first an affine PD-based controller, which was designed by considering the difference between the nonlinear dynamics and its linearized part, and by imposing a certain Lipschitz condition. Moreover, to guarantee the stabilization at the desired configuration state, and based on the first part of this work, some improved LMI conditions are developed where some additional LMI constraints are introduced to reduce the size of the feedback gains. Finally, we adopt the 2-DoF planar manipulator robot to illustrate the validity of the improved LMI conditions and then the efficiency of the adopted affine PD-based controller.

articleTitle: Control And Power Management of DC Microgrid Based Wind/Battery/Supercapacitor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Wind energy systems (WES) have the potential for undesirable fluctuations due to their inherent variability as a renewable energy source (RESs). This issue may be handled by deploying an energy storage technology to stabilize the microgrid's voltage stability (ESSs). PMS is shown in this work, which is a standalone DC Microgrid (DCMG) powered wind energy conversion system with hybrid battery-supercapacitor (BSE) energy storage (SCs). The supercapacitor regulates fast-changing power surges, whilst the battery stabilizes intermediate-changing power surges in the proposed system. The wind turbine uses an MPPT control to monitor the wind speed and alter the duty ratio of the boost converter to record the maximum power point. Using bidirectional DC–DC converters, energy storage devices and the DC link may interchange power in both directions, lowering the DC bus voltage. In MATLAB Simulink, the suggested control process is implemented, and the results are shown for a variety of real-world examples and scenarios.

articleTitle: Survey of Various Graphical Password Techniques and Their Schemes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: User authentication mostly relies on using the text password methods for its simplicity; however, it is often predictable and vulnerable to some common attacks. To overcome the shortcomings of the text password, alternative authentication methods have been introduced, including graphical password authentication methods. The graphical password technique depends on users choosing a series of images, patterns, or drawing something to be the password. Although the graphical password technique helps users to remember their passwords better, this technique is also vulnerable to some attacks. This paper provides a summary of authentication methods and a survey for several graphical password techniques, where these techniques are categorized into three categories: Recognition-based technique, Recall-based technique, and Hybrid technique. In addition, a study of the schemes of each technique and a summary of the attacks against this technique were presented. This paper can help researchers to design more secure graphical password schemes based on the results of this study, which helps in designing new schemes with more usability and security features.

articleTitle: Influence of Spatial Correlation Over the Channel Estimation in 6G Cell-Free Massive MIMO Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Within this paper, we use the Bayesian Minimum mean square error channel estimation (CE)to handle the uplink pilot-based channel estimate procedure in a cell-free (CF) Massive multiple-input multiple-output MIMO (M-MIMO) grid that runs under the TDD protocol. Moreover, we consider the spatial correlation (SC) between channels, as it describes a more practical scenario. Furthermore, we describe the SC using the Gaussian local scattering model. In addition, we investigate the influence of SC over CE in a CF grid using the eigenvalues decomposition. We also examine the performance of a small-cell (SCell) grid, where the SCell grid is only a particular case of a CF grid, in which the user is served by one access point. To back up our results, numerical results are provided.

articleTitle: Power Management and Sizing Optimization for Hybrid Grid-Dependent System Considering Photovoltaic Wind Battery Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Energy Management Strategy (EMS) as a control strategy for microgrid (MG) systems is a complex task to operate the integrated power systems and utilize consumer-based. Alternative energy sources such as solar and wind can be used to generate energy that can be used to power electrical appliances when combined with energy storage units. Additionally, with other sources to complement the drawbacks of each source. But the common drawback of the aforementioned sources are naturally unpredictable and climatology changes dependent. The main aim of this study is to minimize the cost and losses of the system, contrary, maximizing the renewability. This study considers a Tripoli-Libya as a case study located in the north of Libya and coordinated between32.88<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sup> N latitude and 13.19<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sup> E longitude. The system utilizes night-time for exchanging the power between the Electric Vehicle (EV) and the utility grid to form Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) technology. The result of the study shows that the Cost of Energy (COE), Renewable Energy Fraction (REF), and Deficiency Power Supply Probability (DPSP), are an objective of the study along with the analysis of collected data based on the Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm (GOA) using Matlab. The acquired result for the sizing system configuration has been validated with nature-inspired metaheuristic algorithms.

articleTitle: Comparative Study Between a Novel Direct Torque Control and Indirect Field Oriented Control of Three-Phase Induction Motors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Three-phase induction motors are still dominant operators for many modern industrial applications. Many control methods implemented to control the speed and torque of induction motors in applications such as electric vehicles. The main objective of this paper is to compare the performance of a three-phase induction motor controlled by using a novel Direct Torque Control (DTC) method and Indirect Field Oriented Control (IFOC) method. MATLAB/SIMULINK program is used to make a complete computer model of the induction motor. Then, the speed of the computer model is controlled using a novel DTC and IFOC respectively. It is concluded that the novel DTC is suitable for constant reference speed applications, and IFOC method is suitable for applications that required variable reference speed.

articleTitle: Digital Image Watermarking Method Based on LSB and DWT Hybrid Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The watermarking technique can be considered as an important mechanism to protect the Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) of multimedia contents. Currently, most of multimedia contents are exchanged online in a digital form, which exposes the content to be illegal alteration easily without recognize theoffenders. Digital watermarking is used to embed a watermark into the digital media in such away that can not be discovered from the original watermarked data. Consequently, the watermark can be removed and used to verify the copyright ownership of that digital media. In this paper, a hybrid watermarking technique based on Least Significant Bit (LSB) and Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) is introduced and explained.. In order to investigate the effectiveness of the proposed hybrid technique in terms of robustness and imperceptibility, a comparison between the three techniques is also presented. This comparison was carried out using Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR), Mean Square Error (MSE), and Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM). The SSIM results were very close to 1, which means that the recovered watermarks from watermarked image were not distorted in the three cases. The PSNR and MSE values show that the quality of the watermarked images using the proposed technique is better compared to that watermarked images using standalone LSB and DWT. Moreover, the results prove that the proposed hybrid technique was more effective in terms of robustness and imperceptibility compared to LSB and DWT techniques

articleTitle: Facial Emotion Recognition Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In the field of human-computer interaction, facial expression recognition is a hot topic (HCI).Automatic facial expression analysis has been the topic of various studies due to its practical utility in friendly robotics, medical treatment, driver fatigue detection, and many other human-computer interaction systems. Due to the variability of human faces and differences in photos such as varied facial poses and illumination, accurate and robust FER by computer models remains a challenge. Deep learning models have showed tremendous promise among all FER techniques because to their powerful automatic feature extraction and computational efficiency. On the FER2013 dataset, we attain the greatest classification accuracy in this paper. Used a system that combines the VGG 16 model and Classic Neural Networks. Where the VGG16 model is used to extract features and Classic Neural Networks was used to categorization On the FER-2013 dataset, the model achieves state-of-the-art accuracy of 89.31 percent.

articleTitle: Connectivity-Based Dissemination Protocol for VANET
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The dissemination protocol is a very important design aspect of Vehicular Networks (VANETs). In this paper, Connectivity Based Dissemination Protocol (CBDP) is presented to meet the Quality of Service (QoS) requirements of different application classes in VANET. The protocol is deployed on an underlying control scheme for which connectivity measures have been analyzed for both Vehicle to Vehicle (V2V) and Vehicle to Infrastructure (V2I) communication. The fundamental characteristics of the proposed CBDP are: the protocol leads to efficient utilization of frequency spectrum and this alleviates the lack of reliability of IEEE 802.11p communication standard, additionally the protocol prevents the well-known hidden terminal issue. Extensive analytical and simulation results proved the stability of the developed underlying scheme and the effectiveness of the CBDP protocol. Moreover, a simulation comparison is carried out, revealing that CBDP outperforms the traditional Information-rich ORP protocol when employed in the vehicular environment.

articleTitle: Semi-empirical models of electron beam control in radiation technologies
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The work is devoted to the development of semi-empirical models for describing the depth-dose distribution in the layer depending on the angle of incidence of the electron beam. A geometric model of the region of energy transfer from an individual electron to a layer of matter with small effective values of charge and atomic number is proposed. Relationships are obtained in the form of integral transformations of the depth-dose distribution at normal incidence of the electron beam on the layer, which make it possible to calculate the depth-dose distribution for different angles of incidence of electrons. Algorithms were developed and software was implemented to determine the depth-dose distribution at various angles of incidence of the electron beam on the layer. A series of computer experiments on modeling depth dose distributions in a layer at different angles of incidence of electron beams was performed in a detailed physical model using the Monte Carlo method. Comparison of the results of calculations obtained within the framework of the proposed model with the results of modeling by the Monte Carlo method made it possible to determine the empirical parameters of the model and to estimate the range of applicability of the developed semi-empirical model. The possibilities of expanding the range of applicability of the developed semi-empirical model by modifying the geometric models of energy transfer from an individual electron to a layer of matter are discussed.

articleTitle: Comparison Between Global MPPT Techniques for PV Array Systems Subjected to Different Partially Shaded Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Solar photovoltaic (PV) has been shown to be the most reliable source for harvest solar energy. Under varying temperatures and sunshine irradiation, a maximum power point tracking (MPPT) controller was used to make the PV module operate at its maximum power point (MPP). One global MPP and several local MPPs comprise the properties of a solar array under partial shade. Conventional MPPT methods are incapable of reaching global MPP. In this order, the optimization techniques were utilized to extract the GMPP under partial shade conditions (PSCs). Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Flower Pollination Algorithm (FPA), and Cuckoo Search (CS) are three frequently utilized optimization techniques that are compared in this paper. The simulation was developed using Matlab/Simulink software to evaluate the tracking performance of MPPT under different partial shading patterns. The results indicate that PSO, FPA and CS-based trackers ensure converging to the global MPP. In addition, In terms of tracking speed, accuracy, and efficiency, the three algorithms' performance is compared. Among the three algorithms, the CS MPPT method had the best tracking efficiency.

articleTitle: Voltage imbalance investigation in residential LV distribution networks with rooftop PV system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Voltage imbalance is a common power quality problem in power grids. The penetration of the single-phase PV system will affect the voltage imbalance indicator of the low and medium voltage distribution network. Since there is no adequate monitoring point in the distribution network, the evaluation method for assessing the voltage imbalance indicator is of paramount importance, given the stochastic nature of the location and classification of the PV panels. In this paper, the effect of power injection from a single-phase PV rooftop system in the low voltage distribution network on voltage unbalance was studied, by performing a simulation by using the NEPLAN Power Systems Simulation Software. The results show that for the balanced PV case for balanced/unbalanced load, an average power injection of approximately 3 kW–7 kW per bus on the LV distribution grid would not push the voltage unbalance beyond the 2–3% limits. In a worst-case scenario, where all of the PVs would be connected to the same phase and a maximum unbalanced load would be applied, the power injection per bus may be up to 3 kW and 4.5 kW before reaching the same voltage unbalance limits. Whereas in the case of changing the length of the line, the voltage imbalance changes approximately in a direct proportion with the change in the length of the line.

articleTitle: Practical Implementation of A Modified Hybrid Bridge Multi-level Inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: To reduce losses and expenses, multilevel inverter (MLI) researchers have recently been focused in minimizing the number of switches and providing the appropriate level of total harmonic distortion (THD %) of the output voltage waveform. In this paper, a single phase asymmetrical CHB-MLI that uses only 7 switches and 2 DC supplies to generate a 9- level output waveform was proposed as against the use of 16 switches and 4 DC supplies in a conventional CHB-MLI. The study was carried out using MATLAB Simulink; the inverter was also installed and operated in actual experiments. The results obtained from MATLAB Simulink were compared with the results of the actual experiments. The phase disposition pulse width modulation approach Which symbolizes (PD-PWM) as was used to control the suggested topology.

articleTitle: Wideband Angled Dipole Array Antenna with a Suppressed Sidelobe Levels For Beamforming Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper presents a wideband angled dipole antenna and its array with a suppressed sidelobe levels. The paper will compare the effects of adding a perpendicular reflector to the antenna parameters. The proposed antenna consists of two angled dipoles of different lengths to broaden the bandwidth. The distance between the dipoles was adjusted to minimize the return loss between the two main resonance. The antenna array of four symmetrical angled dipole and perpendicular reflector and using nonuniform T-junction power divider was investigated. A useable bandwidth of 3GHz between 5 to 8 GHz was obtained from the four-elements array with a sidelobe level less than -28dB

articleTitle: Using of Neural Network-Based Controller to Obtain the Effect of Hub Motors Weight on Electric Vehicle Ride Comfort
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Hub motor technology has piqued researchers' interest in now a days on account of the multiple benefits it provides. Nevertheless, because the straight connection of the hub motor to the wheels can upshot in developing the vehicle's unsprung weight, this increase in unsprung weight has become one of the important studies in the field of electric vehicles. In this article, a quarter car suspension system was investigated to see how the weight of the hub motor affected the car's performance, passenger comfort, and road holding, then the results compared with the use of standard wheels. In this work, one of the well-known control methods was used, which is the Neural Network-Based Control .The simulation results showed that the increase in wheel mass due to the addition of a hub motor had a small negative effect on the performance of the car suspension system.

articleTitle: Wavelet Transform Based Image Fusion for Brain Tumor Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The main objective of this paper is to propose wavelet transform based image fusion algorithm. The knowledge is to improve the image content by f Using computer tomography (CT) imaging and magnetic resonance (MRI), in order to enhance the tumor detection. The MRI and CT image fusion technology are obtained by taking the absolute maximum of the wave coefficients to obtain more brightness and preserve the features of the two merged images, and thus the wavelet techniques can produce better results to calculate the algorithm effectiveness by the wavelet fusion parameters like number of decompositions and image quality scale, by using the scales to determine image merging efficiency to Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Factor Entropy (Entropy). The obtained results showed that this proposed algorithm produced acceptable results and improved the image quality

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of a hybrid power system for Hospital in Sabratha, Libya via HOMER software
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: With the rise in electricity prices and the need to reduce environmental pollution, renewable energy-based hybrid energy systems became the ideal solution to these problems. Therefore, New technologies are being developed to extract energy from every available source and store the excess energy generated for later usage. Thus, the hybrid energy system (HES) is a collection of various renewable power resources such as solar, wind, geothermal, hydro, tidal, etc. This paper studies the feasibility of powering sabratha’s general hospital with electricity using a solar-wind hybrid power plant. The solar and wind characteristics of the site was taken from the National Aeronautics and Space Administration agency (NASA). A 10kW wind turbine was used for the wind system while a 350w solar panel was used in the solar system. Therefore, the optimizations and simulations of the proposed system were performed with Hybrid Optimization of Multiple Energy Resources (HOMER) software. In order to determine the optimal combination, the wind and PV system as well as the batteries and generator systems were selected on the basis of the Net Present Cost and the highest renewable energy production from the simulation results. The general hospitals load consists of 430kW peak and 6MWh/d. The results show optimization performance for production at PV array 1507.73MWh/yr, wind turbine 596.81MWh/yr and generator 588.31 MWh/yr while the cost of energy was found to be $0.182/KWh.

articleTitle: TCP Congestion Analysis of Wired and Wireless Links Using NS3
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Congestion and traffic control is one of the Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) functions. The performance of TCP depends on the algorithm applied to detect packet drop or delay as an indication to congestion. There are lots of TCP algorithms targeted for different network scenarios such as heavy traffic, low buffer, and low link utilization. This paper demonstrates an evaluation of average throughput and packet drop as metrics for different TCP algorithms in wired and wireless topologies. In other words, this paper analyzes the quality of TCP Reno, TCP New Reno, TCP Vegas, TCP Bic, TCP Cubic, TCP High Speed, TCP Westwood, and TCP Yeah based on wired and wireless models. Wireless model was based on 802.11 N. Both models are analyzed using Bandwidth-Delay Product (BDP). The NS3 simulation results show that Bic and Cubic perform well based on network utilization speed. When considering delay and packet loss metrics, TCP Vegas is more efficient than the other compared algorithms.

articleTitle: BER Performance Analysis using TCM Coding Over AWGN and Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The demands for wireless communication with high data rate is required in many data communication systems. In the most of wireless communications many researches focus on evaluating and improving the systems for high data rate services and spectral efficiency that satisfy higher number of users and better channel capacity requirements. The channel capacity (bandwidth), modulation scheme and coding techniques are the key parameters for evaluating system performance with an improved data rate without increasing the channel bandwidth (Bit/Hz,) which can be achieved for wireless system using orthogonal space-time block code (OSTBC) with recent Multi-Input Multi- Output (MIMO) Systems.This paper focuses on evaluating the performance of the 8-PSK modulation scheme with and without applying the trellis-coded modulation (TCM) coding technique over AWGN, Rayleigh and Rician channels using Multi Input Multi Output (MIMO system to achieve a reasonable Bit Error Rate (BER) performance while the proposed system implements multi antenna diversity of 2x3, where the transmitting antennas are two and the receiving antennas are three.The achieved simulation results in both cases of 8-PSK with and without applying the TCM indicated that a more Eb/No energy is need for the 8-PSK without applying the TCM to get the same BER compared to 8-PSK with TCM coding. Therefore, applying this coding technique improved the performance on average by about 3 dB.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Dipole Ultra Wide Band Antenna for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This research work, design and analysis of dipole Ultra-Wideband (UWB) antenna for wireless applications is proposed and investigated. To enhance the impedance patch better, the antenna was built with a double circular patch dipole with a compact size linear tapered balun at the antenna feed. The suggested antenna is engraved on a FR4 printed circuit board (PCB) with a physical dimension of (38461.6mm3), a relative permittivity of 4.3, and a loss tangent of 0.018. A parametric study of the circular radiating element was introduced to improve and transition from a conventional narrow band to a broader band as well as for antenna size reduction. Results showed that the antenna functions entirely on UWB band (4.2 to 6.6 GHz). The standing wave ratio is less than 2 (SWR<2) along of operation bandwidth. The antenna exhibited omnidirectional radiation patterns and also had a gain suitable for UWB applications. CST Microwave Studio has been used to successfully simulate the proposed antenna. The outcomes of the simulation and measurement are in good accord, confirming the design concept.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Nine Two-Parameter Probability Distributions for Modeling Wind Speed Data at Three Sits in Western Mountain-Libya
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Many studies in the literature have been carried out to find a suitable statistical model in order to describe wind energy potential. Due to the fact that wind speed is the most significant parameter in evaluating the wind energy potential, and because it is a random phenomenon, statistical approaches will be extremely helpful in estimating it. Consequently, probability distributions may be used to estimate wind speed probabilities, which can then be used to forecast wind speed. When estimating the potential wind energy, it is critical to get an accurate calculation of the probability distribution for wind speed data. In this paper nine two-Parameters distributions named Rayleigh (R), Weibull (W), Gumbel (GU), gamma (GA), lognormal (LN), invers Gaussian (IG), normal (NO), logistics (LO) and Nakagami (NA) were employed to ascertain a suitable distribution for wind speed data at three sits Grain, Yafran and Nalut which located in the western mountain – Libya.The goodness of fit tests and the fitted graphics of probability distribution function (PDF) and cumulative distribution function (CDF) have been used to selecting the proper distribution Based on the graphical and the computed goodness of fit results, general inference can be made that Gamma distribution would be the best model for which fitted the data very well for Grain sit, while invers Gaussian distribution was the best model for Nalut sit, finally lognormal distribution was the best model for Yafran sit.

articleTitle: A New algorithm for a novel physiotherapy robot for upper-lower limbs
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper presents a novel algorithm for a new upper-lower limb physiotherapy robot, which is characterized by simplicity of manufacture and ease of use. The main contribution of this research is the design of a robot that can perform a physiotherapy exercise for a very low cost of the used equipment, as well as the ability for patients to use this robot at home and immediately after suffering a disability or undergoing physiotherapy-related surgeries. The pulse width (PW) transmitted to the servo motor, which controls the robot's movement angle, is controlled by the Arduino microcontroller. Using LabVIEW software, the Arduino was programmed, and a Graphical User Interface (GUI) was built to allow the user to establish the setpoints and monitor the exercise session. The experimental findings, which evaluated the requisite movement angles with the required speed and repetitions, were good, showing that the robot could be utilized in practice and that it may be a marketable product.

articleTitle: Design and development Intelligent Medical Care Bed Using Voice Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Recently, with the development of technology in the medical and industrial fields, which contributed to the arrival of this technology to smart homes and life-saving hospitals for people to stay in their homes in a comfortable place where the normal situation for their lives, independence and freedom, and maintaining their security and health,. Message Sheet offers a specially designed medical care bed for patients in homes, nursing homes, hospitals or other people who need some special treatment and any form of health care by voice command. To control the smart bed system with the use of sensors capable of transmitting voice-activated signals, Numerous settings and capabilities are accessible via voice commands, including changeable height for the full bed, head and foot, and customizable temperature. Medical beds for patients and the elderly are now available. If the patient has a disorder that makes it impossible for them to live independently at home, this device allows them to be self-sufficient and does not require the assistance of others as in the past. It's all part of keeping up with research and development by incorporating smart technology into hospital beds to improve comfortability and limit the frequency of preventable diseases like pressure ulcers, which can occur when people stay in bed for lengthy periods of time. It is a network of electronic, mechanical, and digital components that are all working together.

articleTitle: Predictive control of fractional Hammerstein models
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Given that the Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) of fractional Hammerstein models has not been well established, in literature, this work focuses on the NMPC based on these models. The algorithm is developed using two optimization methods, the Gradient Based Method (GBM) and the Nelder Mead Method (NM). The schemes are tested on models studied in the literature and they are compared in tracking performances and computing times.

articleTitle: CKP-PHR app:Smartphone Application For Personal Health Records of Children with Kidney Disease
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Recently, with the increase of using smartphones, there has been a great interest in using mobile applications in the healthcare field. There is a wide variety of healthcare mobile applications that provide different types of services for patients such as diagnosis assistance, follow-up, documentation management, etc. Healthcare Information Technology (HIT) typically deals with Electronic Medical records (EMR), which can also be used interchangeably with Electronic Health Records (EHR). Both are used in clinical documentation and can be easily accessed using smartphones. Patients with chronic diseases have important paper medical reports that help doctors in making medical decisions when diagnosing any health problems in the future. Still, these medical documents are liable to be lost or damaged. Also, a patient may have difficulty finding a particular document from a large collection of medical documents. This paper develops a mobile application that allows managing personal patient health records (such as medical reports, prescriptions, and laboratory results). In particular, the scope of this paper focuses on the personal health records of kidney patients of Benghazi Children's Hospital. This prototype includes information on Kidney disease for children, a user's main menu, medical history data gathering, medical report recording, and analysis findings. With its simple design and user-friendly, users with chronic diseases can use this app to stay in touch with their doctors and live a healthy lifestyle. The application is developed in an Android environment based on databases on the cloud to provide data anytime and anywhere, making it easier for the doctor to diagnose and monitor his disease correctly from anywhere.

Author Keywords: Children Kidney Patient Personal Health Records

articleTitle: Optimization of Basic 25 Gb/s TDM-PON for New Era Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: High data rates over a single wavelength are required to meet and satisfy customer requirements for various new telecommunication applications. Therefore, encourage the full-service access network (FSAN) to choose a Time and Wavelength Division Multiplexing-Passive Optical Network (TWDM-PON) structure as a competitive candidate to upgrade the PON system data rate. IEEE and (ITU-T) announced single and multiple channels of the 25 G-EPON standards either by building a single line of the 50 Gb/s TDM-PON system or two lines of the 25 Gb/s TDM-PON. In addition, the Multi-Source Agreement (MSA) group adopted a single line of 25 GS-PON standards. Thus, deep research work is needed to evaluate these upgrades. The present investigation aims to configure and utilize the basic scheme of the 4×25 Gb/s TWDM-PON system for downstream signals to reach the 100 Gb/s PON capacity system. The progress of the method has been achievable due to the Opti.System package. The software provides an excellent infrastructure to test and analyze the overall model performance. The wavelength plan from the C-band to the O-band is applied to mitigate chromatic dispersion (CD) and improve the received signals. The system distance reaches 23 km at a maximum of 128 end-users/wavelength. An opened eye diagram and acceptable BER and a Q factor values are obtained to investigate transmission quality. As a result, the outcomes of downstream signals are reasonable. Nevertheless, the optical reach is limited to 23 km at a 1:128 split ratio, so the split ratio of 1 to 256 users/ at a 20 km distance is our future work.

articleTitle: Improve the Detection and Segmentation of Lung Nodule X-ray Images
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: A combination of three lung nodule detectors has been proposed in this paper, also a new combination of lung nodule segmentation algorithm has been proposed. The proposed detector called Combined Lung Nodule Detector and the proposed segmentation is called Combined Distance Threshold (CDT). The dataset images used in this paper to evaluate lung nodule detection and segmentation is Japanese Society of Radiological Technology (JRST) which consist of 100 malignant cases plus 54 benign cases containing one nodule each. It is clear from results that the results of the CLND detector and CDT segmentation are better than the common traditional methods. As show in Fig. 7 (which represent as prove of concept) that the new proposed detector and the lung nodule segmentation algorithm can enhance the performance of Computer Aided Diagnoses system (CAD) which increase the performance of early detection of cancered lung nodule so can be treated early.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Multimedia over MPLS VPN and IPSec Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this paper multimedia streaming applications is performance is evaluated over MPLS network using two VPN techniques MPLS VPN and IPSec using OPNET simulation tool. However, to make the analysis study more realistic HTTP and FTP traffics are also injected into the tested scenarios and measured. VPN exploits encryption to provide data’s confidentiality transmitted through the VPN tunnels. MPLS VPN connects sites over public networks using private labeled switched paths (LSPs) established on MPLS networks. IPSec certifying sender authentication, keeping data’s confidentiality by encryption, and provides data integrity.The experimental results showed that IPSec is performed better than MPLS VPN in terms of end-to-end delay and packet delay variation. Moreover, OSPF protocol is employed as routing protocol also incurred more traffic in MPLS VPN than IPSec scenario. In addition, H.323 as a multimedia protocol is also recorded longer setup time in the case of MPLS VPN than IPSec scenario.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of 80 Gb/s XGS-PON Configuration for Future Co-Existing Scenario
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This article simulates and configures the eight-channel 10-Gigabit-capable symmetric passive optical network scheme using Opti. System software. The investigation and examination of the system parameters, the input power, link reach, and splitting ratio and their impact on overall network performance. The bite error rate 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> and Quality Factor more than 6 is considered to evaluate the model. Firstly, the effects of the transmission reach found the accepted bit error rate and Quality factor for 64 Optical Network Unit compared to 128 Optical Network Unit. Moreover, the test provides a good Optical Distribution Network loss for different splitting ratios. Secondly, the 25 Km and 1:64 splitter results show that the bit error rate of the λ1 is better than λ8. Finally, it is interesting to attempt this investigation using the Return zero data format. The opening eye diagram is cleared than using non return zero format. So, the implementation of 80 Gb/s wave division multiplexing eight channel of 10-Gigabit-capable symmetric passive optical network would be a part of an excellent solution to meet the capacity demands of access networks.

articleTitle: Performance analysis and simulation design of a soft switching Cuk DC/DC converter with controllers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper proposes a design simulation of a soft-switching Cuk DC to DC Converter with a single switch. By eliminating extra switches, the proposed converter can be controlled with a controller. A single MOSFET is used as a power switch that turns on at zero-current switching (ZCS) and turns off at zero-voltage switching (ZVS) conditions. Analysis of Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) between the proposed converter and two switched converter clearly showed the novelty of the suggested converter with improved quality. The proposed converter can operate at high switching frequencies and with high output for an extensive load scale. The simulation of MATLAB/ Simulink with 100W/50Khz soft-switched Pulse-width modulation (PWM) Cuk converter produced 100 W from 100 V input voltage while reducing current stress and extra switch loss. A comparison of the proposed soft-switched Cuk and conventional Cuk converter is taken into account. PID and PI controllers are employed in this study to investigate the performance and stability of the proposed converter. Under any influence of different parasitic resistance Ron of switching power devices, load conditions, and variable input voltage, the proposed converter can provide robust output voltage with improved dynamic performance operated with linear controllers.

articleTitle: Assessment of Healthcare Workers’ Level of Knowledge and Practices of Using Robotics During Covid-19
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The outbreak of the coronavirus created a conventional challenge for the global community due to the lack increased a number of COVID-19 positive patients and stretched healthcare systems. Therefore, the global world starts to look for unconventional approaches and technologies to combat the dissemination of the COVID-19 virus, for example, utilizing Robotics and Artificial Intelligence. Using robotics for medical services is facing many challenges that may lead to failure. The most important of these challenges is that the healthcare workers are not trained well on using robotics, don’t have enough knowledge, awareness of the importance of using robotics especially during pandemics, and the relatively high cost of robotics. Thus, in this paper, we assess the levels of knowledge, attitude, and practices of healthcare workers about using robotics during pandemics. Further, a quantitative and a qualitative approach using a questionnaire to collect data is used. Over 40 healthcare workers participate, who have a fair background about robots. However, they have no idea about using robots in general and their field in particular.

articleTitle: State Estimation of an Inverted Pendulum on Cart System by Kalman Filtering and Optimal Control (LQG)
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The main objective of this study is to estimate and control the states of a nonlinear electromechanical system (Inverted Pendulum on cart). Designing a controller for this type of system is a quite challenging problem in the control field. The method of study is a Linear quadratic regulator (LQR). For tracking a reference input, this optimal controller with a cost function, in which arguments are based on weighted states and control effort, is theoretically implemented. The states of the system are not always available; therefore, an estimation process is required. State estimation based on Kalman filtering is used to introduce the states for the controller to operate on them. The investigation procedure of the system’s response is based on regulation, tracking, and state disturbance interference. The state trajectories and the system’s overall performance are documented by MatLab/ Simulink model. Last, the simulation results are explained and discussed according to this criteria.

articleTitle: Iris Recognition Using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Today, iris recognition becomes one of the most popular and useful techniques used for person verification, which takes advantage of the fact that the eye has some unique characteristics represented by the iris or more precisely in the pupil. Iris scanning biometric systems measure the unique patterns in the iris of human’s eye to verify and authenticate their identity. Fast, contactless and renowned for its accuracy, biometric iris recognition can work at long distance with some solutions that leverage the modality requiring only a glance from a user. This paper presents a study on the performance of iris recognition system using PYTHON for implementation and CASIA-V I iris databases as training and testing images where seven hundreds of iris images were used. The measurements demonstrated our model provides higher identification accuracy than the VGG16 model.

articleTitle: Multispectral palmprint recognition based on three descriptors: LBP, Shift LBP, and Multi Shift LBP with LDA classifier
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Local Binary Patterns (LBP) are extensively used to analyze local texture features of an image. Several new extensions to LBP-based texture descriptors have been proposed, focusing on improving noise robustness by using different coding or thresholding schemes. In this paper we propose three algorithms (LBP), Shift Local Binary Pattern (SLBP), and Multi Shift Local Binary Pattern (MSLBP),to extract features for palmprint images that help to obtain the best unique and characteristic values of an image for identification. The Principal Component Analysis (PCA) algorithm has been applied to reduce the size of the extracted feature matrix in random space and in the matching process; the Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) algorithm is used. Several experiments were conducted on the large multispectral database (blue, green, red, and infrared) of the University of Hong Kong. As result, distinguished and high results were obtained where it was proved that, the blue spectrum is superior to all spectra perfectly.

articleTitle: Private Tutoring During COVID in Jordan. Improving Academic Performance, or Chasing After an Illusion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Online learning has been the center of the education systems around the world for approximately two years now. Since the COVID pandemic appeared, many nations have resorted to online learning formats in their schools and higher education institutes. Consequently, private tutoring in all education levels started to rise as students were trying to cope with the sudden changes in their courses. However, the effect of private tutoring is somewhat ambiguous due to the lack of feedback from students. This study presents an online survey on students’ experiences with private tutoring in the higher education institutions in Jordan. A total of 107 students participated in this study from different academic levels. The results of the survey showed that 63% of participants believed that the online learning format in their courses was one of the reasons they went to private tutoring. However, nearly half of the sample did not believe that instructors played a role in them resorting to private tutoring. The results also showed that senior level students believed that private tutoring improved their academic standings. In fact, their answers were statistically significantly different than students from the other academic levels. The results also showed that students in the lower academic levels (freshmen, and sophomores) expressed their disappointment in the outcomes of private tutoring.

articleTitle: Ensemble machine learning model for classification of handwritten digit recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Recognizing handwritten numbers is a commonly used application in machine learning. It is used in various applications, including postal mail sorting zip code recognition, writer identification and verification, diacritical processing, and recognition of handwritten digits on a bank check. Each of the 10 digits (0-9) is designated as a category in the context of machine learning-based classification tasks. However, due to the variety of handwriting styles from one person to another, it difficult for a person to distinguish. In addition, each learning algorithm may have its own set of benefits and drawbacks, implying that one algorithm may be able to learn some but not all of the special aspects of handwritten numbers. In order to enhance the effectiveness of the categorization process, a technique for reading handwritten numbers has been presented. Using a convolutional neural network architecture, the image properties of handwritten numerals are retrieved (CNN). Additionally, to train the classifiers, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), and Logistic Regression Model were utilized (LRM). The group classifier was able to achieve a recognition accuracy of 98 percent in the experiments using the MNISET dataset.

articleTitle: Enhancement the routing protocols in sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSN) usually contains sensors powered by small batteries with limited power. These sensors collect data and transfer it to the base station (BS) where it will be manipulated; the process of data transfer could be direct or indirect depending on the used protocol. The batteries’ limited power will be partially consumed during every data transfer process. In some applications, such as agricultural, military and others, WSN use a large number of these sensors, so the energy consumption should be taken into consideration during the design of such networks as the batteries’ replacement is sometimes very difficult and expensive. Many researchers have been working on inventing the best battery-conserving protocols to extend the lifetime of the network. Low Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy (LEACH) protocol have better power-saving performance in this field, where the network is divided into groups called clusters, and each cluster selects its cluster head (CH). Sensors will transfer its data to the CH that belongs to it which in turn will transfer this data to the BS. However, a selection of CHs that ignores a node's energy change will cause the nodes serving as CHs to die earlier than the other nodes as too much energy is consumed. Also, the high frequency of re-use wastes a certain amount of energy. In order to distribute the power consumption evenly between the different nodes, we intend to classify the CH according to its distance from the BS, one operating at a close distance from the BS and the other at a far distance from it. The CH in the far distance will transfer its data not directly to the BS but through CH near to the BS. We aim with this proposal to distribute the energy consumption evenly between the nodes. Simulation results show that the proposed protocol GE-LEACH gives better results in the lifetime of the node especially in a field with a large area

articleTitle: Voltage Control of Stand-alone Single Phase Self Excited Induction Generator for Variable Speed Wind Turbine Using Bang Bang-PWM Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: For the last decades the self-excited induction generators (SEIG) getting more attention as the most suitable power solution for remote and rural areas or where a grid supply is not available. due to their advantages, especially self-protection because the induced voltage will break down in case of an overload or a short circuit occurs at its terminals.Due to the simplicity, reliability, robustly, maintenance almost free and low overall cost, the squirrel cage induction motor (SCIM) is used in this kind of generation systems. producing electric energy by connecting excitation capacitor banks across the auxiliary winding of the motor when its rotor speed runs over the synchronous speed, however, by connecting a constant excitation capacitors the control of the output voltage and frequency cannot be done when the rotor speed vary among of wide rand of wind speed.In this article a method of controlling of single-phase self-exciting induction generator (SPSEIG) by connecting and disconnecting a small value of parallel capacitors, in addition to using the PWM technique to short circuit a capacitor by using a power electronic device (TRIAC) during controlled duty cycles to minimize the difference between the output voltage and a reference voltage for different loading, while the output frequency is unregulated when the rotor speed dropped down up to 80% of rated speed, this output frequency is satisfied for frequency insensitive loads i.e. heating loads, bulb lights and well pumps.In this work an experimental tests on a 220V, 1.5kW single-phase induction machine are made at a wide range of speeds using supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) and Bang Bang-PWM control system over WIFI IEEE 802.11 standard communication between the master terminal unit (MTU) and the remote terminal unit (RTU), and the results were promising and positive.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of VoIP traffic over MANETs Under Different Routing Protocols
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: in recent decades, Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) has been extensively utilised as an individual’s communication method. A mobile ad-hoc network (MANET) is a wireless network that lacks infrastructure and has a topology that can change dynamically over time. Many types of routing protocols were developed for MANET. Every routing protocol has its characteristics. This paper intends to quantitatively evaluate the impact of OLSR, AODV, and DSR on VoIP in MANET. Optimised Network Engineering Tools (OPNET) version 14.5 was selected to experiment. According to the experiment results, the best VoIP performance was under the OLSR protocol.

articleTitle: SSwIoT: Smart Algorithm for IoT Swarm Tasks Allocation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Internet of Things has opened the door for new smart tasks which can be implemented and performed in a collaborative atmosphere. The teamwork paradigm is formed from a collection of nodes that work together as swarms so that the workload is distributed between them (each node performs specific related task(s)). IoT swarm nodes are distributed within clusters and controlled via master node(s). These types of systems are intended to boost productivity, reliability, and lower risks. These swarm systems require smart algorithms to drive them efficiently. Due to technical failures, some nodes might not functioning well or some nodes are heavily loaded while others are nearly free of load. These work balancing issues need to be considered and treated. This paper proposes a new IoT swarm task distribution/reallocation algorithm named SSwIoT. The proposed algorithm tries to address the above work balance issues and maintains the normality of the system's job.

articleTitle: Assessing the Usability and Perceived Usefulness of a Moodle Platform Within Libyan Higher Education Institutions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Moodle has become an important tool in the modern higher education. Higher Education institutions have increasingly adopted their Moodle for learning purposes that allow learners to communicate efficiently. However, several studies have been shown that usability has a significant impact on the success of the students’ learning. Therefore, this study aimed to evaluate the usability of the Moodle system used at Libyan higher education for online computer course. A questionnaire using the System Usability Scale (SUS) have been used, with 157 students recruited from two Higher Institute of Comprehensive Professions one public and the other private to get a reliable number of participants, to investigate whether the system is usable and useful or not. The results indicate that (SUS score of 50.92) of the Moodle which is still performed below the average usability expectation. However, the level of the Moodle usefulness was High. Assessing usability and its effect on Moodle is complicated. Furthermore, evaluating how usable Moodle platforms is needed to ensure that the design of the component of the platform does not impede teaching and learning and therefore there is a need for further work by service providers.

articleTitle: Comparison of Schecduling Schemes in IPV4 and IPV6 to Achieve High QoS
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The Internet has become a very large infrastructure with the massive development required for users. The quality of service has become one of the most important requirements of the Internet with the rapid rate of development. Many services and applications that users need on global networks, including video conferencing, online gaming, file transfer, online communication, and others. The presence of a waiting mechanism or queues is one of the most important requirements for organizing traffic across networks. The transmitted data is temporarily stored while waiting for transmission in the routers in the networks, this is called the waiting system.In this paper, we have compared different scheduling schemes for Quality of Service (QoS) in a careful study of the effects of different queuing algorithms on the performance of many different applications (file transfer protocol, audio and video conferencing) over IPv4 and IPv6 networks using the OPNET designer used to model, simulate and analyze network behavior. The queue algorithms that were selected for comparison are (Weighted Fair Queuing (WFQ), Modified Deficit Round-Robin (MDRR) and Class-based Weighted Fair Queuing (CBWFQ)) The main objective of this paper is to present a study focused on quality of service (QoS) using queues in different systems.

articleTitle: Comparison of Genetic Algorithm Crossover Operators on WSN Lifetime
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper’s purpose is to introduce and present a simulation-based study of the effect of using different crossover operators in a genetic algorithm to extend the life span of a wireless sensor network (WSN) and reduce its overall energy expenditure. One of the genetic algorithm’s pillars is the crossover operator. Crossover operators are classified into four types: one-point crossover, uniform crossover, k-point crossover and hybrid crossover. It is shown that using different types of crossover operators has only a minor impact on WSN lifetime and stability period. When compared to other operators, one-point crossover improves network stability period and throughput slightly.

articleTitle: Assisting Blind People Using Object Detection with Vocal Feedback
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: For visually impaired people, it is highly difficult to make independent movement and safely move in both indoors and outdoors environment. Furthermore, these physically and visually challenges prevent them from in day-to- day live activities. Similarly, they have problem perceiving objects of surrounding environment that may pose a risk to them. The proposed approach suggests detection of objects in real-time video by using a web camera, for the object identification, process. You Look Only Once (YOLO) model is utilized which is CNN-based real-time object detection technique. Additionally, The OpenCV libraries of Python is used to implement the software program as well as deep learning process is performed. Image recognition results are transferred to the visually impaired users in audible form by means of Google text-to-speech library and determine object location relative to its position in the screen. The obtaining result was evaluated by using the mean Average Precision (mAP), and it was found that the proposed approach achieves excellent results when it compared to previous approaches.

articleTitle: Magnetic Field Shielding Behavior of Mesh Wire in Low Frequencies
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of electronics and wireless communication technologies, our daily electromagnetic environment is getting increasingly complicated. A wire mesh is used for shielding electromagnetic fields, which are composed of thin conductive wires that will affect the behavior of electromagnetic fields within it. Most researchers have discussed the influence of electromagnetic fields in solid metal, but few of them have explored the effects of wire mesh shielding. Analytical, the electromagnetic shielding of wire-mesh is determined in several characteristic electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) configurations by using low-frequency models together with a classical analysis. Experimentally, the shielding effectiveness of wire mesh has been measured, through designing the wire mesh shields in different sizes to determine their impact on shielding effectiveness. By changing the size of the aperture, we notice that the shielding effectiveness increases when the size of the aperture decreases.

articleTitle: Cryptography using Affine Hill Cipher Combining with Hybrid Edge Detection (Canny-LoG) and LSB for Data Hiding
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In our time the rapid growth of internet and digital communications has been required to be protected from illegal users. It is important to secure the information transmitted between the sender and receiver over the communication channels such as the internet, since it is a public environment. Cryptography and Steganography are the most popular techniques used for sending data in secrete way. In this paper, we are proposing a new algorithm that combines both cryptography and steganography in order to increase the level of data security against attackers. In cryptography, we are using affine hill cipher method; while in steganography we are using Hybrid edge detection with LSB to hide the message. Our paper shows how we can use image edges to hide text message. Grayscale images are used for our experiments and a comparison is developed based on using different edge detection operators such as (canny-LoG ) and (Canny-Sobel). Their performance is measured using PSNR (Peak Signal to Noise ratio), MSE (Mean Squared Error) and EC (Embedding Capacity). The results indicate that, using hybrid edge detection (canny- LoG) with LSB for hiding data could provide high embedding capacity than using hybrid edge detection (canny- Sobel) with LSB. We could prove that hiding in the image edge area could preserve the imperceptibility of the Stego-image. This paper has also proved that the secrete message was extracted successfully without any distortion.

articleTitle: A Secure MIMO Wireless Communication Systems Based on Hamiltonian Graphs and Artificial Noise
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this article, a secure multiple–input multiple–output (MIMO) wireless communication system is presented and discussed. The proposed system relies on Hamiltonian graphs that are known between the transmitter (Alice) and the legitimate receiver (Bob) and not accessible for any third party intercepter. Lack of knowledge for the proper graph at the eavesdropper (Eve) is shown to substantially degrade the detection capability, where an average bit error rate (ABER) of around 0.5 is reported regardless of the considered signal-to-noise-ratio (SNR) value. The generated graph is used to construct a cycle, where the sequence of data bits to be transmitted at each time instant is converted to a decimal number and the number following this decimal number on the cycle is modulated. As well, Alice transmits a pre designed artificial noise (AN) that is know at Bob but not at Eve to enhance the secrecy rate (SR) of the communication system. It is assumed that Eve is fully aware of the communication protocol and substantial gains in terms of ABER and SR are reported.

articleTitle: Mechanical behavior study of PPCF material as solar photovoltaic backsheet
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The solar panel industry is witnessing great developments, especially in the field of research, making the technology that produces solar electricity cheaper and more efficient, including solar panel backsheet technology. This paper presents a study of the mechanical performance of PPCF material as backsheet for solar PV modules. The studied composite material consisted of 95% polypropylene (PP) reinforced with 5% carbon fiber (CF). The study results showed that the strain rates for PPCF were about 85% higher than those for pure PP, due to the higher tensile strength of carbon fiber reinforced polypropylene material (PPCF). The study also showed that PPCF had longer life without failure compared to PP, even under high stresses.

articleTitle: Control and Design 6-Pulse STATCOM Using Novel 2-Vector Closed Loop Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to solve the power quality problem by injecting a current into the system to correct the voltage sag and reducing the total harmonic distortion (THD) in the distribution line. 2-vector closed loop controller, PLL and dq controller were proposed to control the 6-pulse STATCOM and control the phase shift between the power system current, source voltage and maintain the 1p.u. It is worth mentioning that simulation was carried out using PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Various Deep Learning Techniques for Arabic NLP Syntactic Tasks on Noisy Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Natural language processing (NLP) has three basic tasks divided into two levels, lexical, which includes Tokenization task and syntactic level which includes Part Of Speech tasks (POS) and Name Entity Recognition (NER) tasks. Recent research has demonstrated the effectiveness of deep learning in many NLP tasks including NER, POS, sentiment analysis, language modeling, and other tasks. This study focused on the utilizing of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BLSTM), Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory with Conditional Random Field (BLSTM-CRF), and Long Short-Term Memory with Conditional Random Field (LSTM-CRF) deep learning techniques for tasks at the syntactic level; and to compare their performance on noisy data. The models were trained and tested by using KALIMAT corpus with simulated noise on testing dataset. For evaluation purpose, F1-score was used, where the results of our experiments showed that a BLSTM-CRF model surpassed the rest of other models in the NER task at a low noise level, while the LSTM-CRF model obtained a higher F1-score at a higher noise level. With respect to the POS task, the BLSTM-CRF model gained the highest F1-score in all noise levels equated to the other competitive models.

articleTitle: Performance of Pumping System Under Partial Shading
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The implementation of photovoltaic pumping systems is becoming more and more widespread, particularly for isolated sites. However, it is well known that the performance of these types of installations depends, to a great extent, on climatic changes, in particular temperature and Irradiation. Therefore, as the phenomenon of shading has a direct consequence on the impact of weather conditions on photovoltaic panels, this study aims to optimize the operating conditions of a photovoltaic pumping system.Analysis of system performance under the MatLab / Simulink software environment has shown that optimization techniques force the system to operate at its optimum speed.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of Hydroplaning in Electric and ICE Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Hydroplaning is a dangerous phenomenon that could happen to a driver after hitting a puddle of water during wet weather, which can lead to severe and fatal accidents. Hydroplaning is the loss of contact between tire and road surface due to the increase of hydrodynamic lift force. Moreover, around 20% of wet weather accidents occur due to hydroplaning. Furthermore, the change of the world to electric vehicles is fact that will happen in the next few years. However, one of the main differences between an internal combustion and electric vehicles is the mass which is around 200-450 kg greater in electric vehicles due to batteries. The increase in weight can be useful to decrease the chance of hydroplaning on wet roads. This was analyzed using ABAQUS Coupled Eulerian Lagrangian (CEL) fluid structure interaction (FSI) capabilities. The results showed that the increase in weight due to batteries can decrease the chance of hydroplaning by 54.4%. This can result in decreasing the percentage of wet weather accidents that occur due to hydroplaning from 20% to 10%, if all the vehicles on the road changed to electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Brain Tumor Detection Based on Gradient Boosting Machine -CNN model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Tumors of the brain are one of the most prevalent and severe diseases, due to high mortality rate. Thus, The categorization of brain tumors is crucial for accurate clinical diagnosis and treatment. The aim of this research is to develop a prototype system for detecting brain tumors using the gradient boost algorithm and deep learning model in order to analysis the efficiency. In our proposed method was tested on a data set of 3000 MRI images, and we divided them into (80%)for training and (20%)testing, and then based on the idea of transfer learning and the use of deep convolutional neural networks that have been pre-trained to extract deep features from brain MRI.For the classification stage, At first we applied the concept of deep learning, that is, we used CNN as a classifier and as a feature extractor, and then use same the features with gradient boosting (Gradient Boost, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) algorithms as a classifier. And for the purpose of analyzing the performance of these algorithms, we have implemented other machine learning algorithms (LogisticRegression, Support Vector Machines, Neural network, Adaptive Boosting, Random Forest, Decision Tree, K-Nearest Neighbors) and finally we have compared all the classifiers.the results showed that most of the proposed detection models, whether independent (CNN) or composite models , have high performance in detecting brain tumor and this is one of our goals in this study. Our main goal is to analyze the performance of Gradient Boosting algorithms. Whereas, the Gradient Boosting algorithm was the least effective in classifying with an accuracy of 0.952 and a time of (17m and 3s), followed by LightGBM with an accuracy of 0.979 and a time of (8m and 51s), and CatBoost with an accuracy of 0.974 and a time of(20m and40s), while the XGBoost algorithm had the best performance in this category, with an accuracy of 0.981 but with a larger time of (23m and 3s).

articleTitle: Evaluating the Fast Rerouting with MPLS Networks as a Fault Tolerance Mechanism with OSPF and IS-IS routing protocols
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this paper an analysis study is carried out by GNS3 as a modeling and simulation environment with a Wireshark tool to investigate the reactions taken inside MPLS networks such as path reestablishment and timing (network convergence) of fail/reconnection/rerouting. However, two practical scenarios have been built with MPLS network; one employs OSPF while the other works with IS-IS as routing protocols to examine their responses and behaviors during link and node failure. The results showed that IS-IS is recorded better results than OSPF in network convergence with MPLS networks.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Electric Vehicle Stability Using Fractional PID and Fuzzy PID Based Controllers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The vehicle’s yaw rate and body sideslip angle (BSA) are the most critical characteristics for describing the vehicle’s stability performance. A three-degree-of-freedom planar model of the vehicle is used to improve the vehicle’s yaw stability when front steering is used. We take yaw rate feedback as an input and present a yaw rate control system based on a fuzzy PID and a fractional PID controller. The controllers are designed in such a way that they generate the proper yaw rate, ensuring that the vehicle maintains the desired yaw rate values. A simulation is run in the context of a lane maneuver steering angle. The simulation results indicate that when the vehicle is subjected to a change in line of maneuver, the yaw rate of the controlled vehicle remains close to the desired value while the sideslip angle values degrade when the vehicle is subjected to the same cornering maneuver.

articleTitle: Improving Network’s Performance by Applying Different Quality of Service Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: this paper studies the improvement of Network’s performance using different quality of service (QoS) mechanisms. Classification and marking, Congestion Management, congestion avoidance, policing and shaping QoS mechanisms were applied into a simulated network through five scenarios. Network performance metrics such as delay, jitter, and packet loss were measured afterwards. The implementation done has had great impact on improving network’s performance as delay was decreased to 38msec and jitter to 25msec.

articleTitle: Study of Radio Absorbing Properties of Layered Oxide and Carbon Containing Composite Materials
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The regularities of changing of the values of electromagnetic radiation absorption coefficient of layered oxide and carbon containing composite materials and electromagnetic radiation absorption losses, provided by these ones, depending on this radiation frequency values, varying in the range from 0.7 to 142.8 GHz, have been established. The results of the experimental substantiation of the technique for such materials manufacturing have been presented by the authors in earlier published scientific papers.
