Based on the established regularities, it was determined that layered oxide and carbon containing composite materials absorb the energy of electromagnetic radiation, interacting with them, to the greatest extent if the frequency value of this radiation varies from 16.7 to 26.0 GHz and from 54.0 to 78.0 GHz. It was defined, that the studied materials are suitable for use to ensure the high accuracy and electromagnetic compatibility of microwave measuring equipment.

articleTitle: Using a Multi-Agent System to Better Simultaneous Collaboration Software Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In each field, there is a need for better collaborative efforts among team members. The software development community is currently concentrating its efforts on developing tools that will make this endeavor easier. As a result, the two major purposes of a collaborative system are to solve the lack of community consciousness (since group members must be aware of one another) and to maintain flooring directive (i.e. provide means to manage access to shared resource in synchronous groupware systems). The goal of this study is to design a dynamic, extendable, and adaptable framework capable of handling challenges in synchronous community consciousness systems in order to solve these concerns. The major purpose of this study is to improve Simultaneous Collaboration Software Systems utilizing the structure analysis real-time approach (SART), which is based on a multiagent system (MAS)).

articleTitle: Assessment of Coriolis meters as instrumentation for gas void fraction measurement in air–liquid multiphase flow in a pipeline riser system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Measurement of void fraction in gas-liquid flow systems is important in determining pumping requirements, designing downstream facilities and in detecting off-design problems such as cavitation and flashing during operation. Hence, it is key that this parameter is known in real time during oil & gas production and other process operation. As a result, the use of clamp-on flow meters which operate on the Coriolis principle are useful for such purposes as they instantaneously measure the flow’s density which can change depending on the gas fraction in the flowing mixture. In this study, we demonstrate the use of Coriolis mass flow meters in instantaneously measuring the void fraction in a multiphase mixture flowing in a 2-inch pipeline riser system at Cranfield University, UK. A Coriolis meter was installed on the vertical section of the facility. A set of experiments were conducted at fixed liquid superficial velocities of 0.25 and 1 m/s and air flow rates of 6-100 Sm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/h (corresponding to 0.39–3 m/s). The instantaneous densities of the mixtures were recorded at 100 Hz acquisition frequency. These were then used to estimate the gas void fraction at the vertical section using the homogenous model for the mixture density. Also, a well-calibrated 16 by 16 wire mesh sensor (WMS) fitted at the same vertical location to validate the gas void fraction measurements of the Coriolis flow meter. It was found that the Coriolis flow meter presented excellent agreement with the WMS for void fraction measurement at high gas flow rates. We observed that the agreement coincided with conditions that exhibit core-peaking void fraction distributions, i.e., at conditions that are not bubbly flow. Hence, it may be concluded that the Coriolis flow meter can be used with some confidence in industrial application at these conditions.

articleTitle: Comparison of a Hybrid Power System with a Conventional Diesel System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Normally, to generate electricity and cover the demand for it, primary sources as fossil fuels are used as energy sources. However, the crisis of traditional fuel sources, upward trend in fuel prices, and emissions of harmful gases due to fossil fuel’s burning, posed a challenge to the sustainability of human civilization. Nowadays, renewable energy technologies have attracted greater global attention due to their positive impact on addressing environmental concerns (carbon dioxide emissions leading to global warming) and they have the ability to meet the increasing demand for energy. In addition, lower operating and maintenance costs, as well as ease of setup, have led to greater integration of renewable energy sources. In this paper, by modeling and simulation using MATLAB/SIMULINK software for one day (24 hours) and HOMER software for one year. the off-grid hybrid power system was designed and compared with the conventional system (diesel), for palm village load (residential and industrial load) where As per the renewable resources available in the village the hybrid system design is based on PV and wind energy as main sources of electricity generation and with use of diesel generator as a back-up system to fully supply the demand, storage system (batteries) has been dispensed with because it is expensive and short-lived, The simulation results show that based on the high fuel price of 0.1$ and the availability of renewable energy sources, the hybrid system is better than the diesel system for a rural area far from the electric grid.

articleTitle: A Low-Cost Rehabilitation System for Upper Limb Amputees
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Recently, Rehabilitation systems and artificial limbs have been studied widely in Libya. In this paper, we introduced a low-cost rehabilitation system for upper limbs amputees. SEMG sensor has been designed and made and compared with a commercial sensor by taking data sets from a number of volunteers. The low-cost developed sensor gave a reasonable result that can be used in a virtual reality system, which stimulates the hand movement using a robotic simulator toolkit in LabVIEW Environments. A volunteer amputee tested the system with satisfying results.

articleTitle: Application of Voltage Control Techniques in South Western Libyan Network to Enhance Voltage Stability with Future Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: this paper is focused on studying the voltage control method in Western South Libyan network (Sabha). The western-south region of Libya extends electrically from the Khoms in North to Aweanat in South which is known as Sabha network that works on 220 kV and there is a plan underway to develop the 400 kV network. Due to harsh weather conditions in this mostly desert region which increase power demand for air-condition systems as well as the extensive use of water pumps for agriculture, a high inductive load is yielded. Given this type of inductive load and the long distance that separate the load from the main power generation plants in the North, the phenomenon of voltage collapse occurs especially during peak load which is currently estimated to about 600 MW. The study considered herein is concerned with obtaining practical solutions to avoid the occurrence of this problem in the future by proposing three resolutions. First by the completion of projects such as upgrading the voltage level of the transmission system to 400 kV; secondly, by localizing the Ubari station with 600MW, and thirdly, by the injection of Static Var Compensator in the 220 kV Sabha bus and taking into account the load growth in the region, which increases annually by the range of 7% 10%. The NEPLAN software is utilized with all the data that available from GECOL to evaluate these different scenarios.

articleTitle: PalmPrint Recognition using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Palmprint recognition system is gaining popularity in the biometrics research field, and it is considered as one of the most essential behavioral aspects of biometrics. The proposed approach was evaluated using the Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU) palmprint database and a non-classical technique for palmprint recognition using InceptionResnet-v2 pre-trained deep neural networks (DNNs) and by adding some layers such as fully connected with Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU), dropout, and fully connected with softmax. And received a score of 99.21% with loss validation 0.173 %.

articleTitle: Compartment Models for Drug Diffusion in the Body
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Compartment models are represented in terms of ordinary differential equations in order to model the concentration of the medicine in the body in the literature. This model helps in understanding the way of medicine diffusion when taken orally or via injections. By solving these equations, it is possible to determine the key characterizing medicine’s parameters in the blood. In this paper, two compartmental models, namely one and two compartments, were considered to fit experimental data for two case studies, from the literature, and key medicine parameters related to the behavior of the medicine in the body were calculated. The underlying equations of the model were implemented in MATLAB software where a designed graphical user-interface GUI receives the dose of the medicine, time of blood samples' taking and the concentration of the medicine. The study concluded that the accuracy of the obtained mathematical model depends on the quality of the input data. This study has a number of applications in medicine control, medicine dosage and other pharmaceutical problems.

articleTitle: A novel passive cooling for photovoltaic module temperature reduction using truncated fins: simulation study
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper aims to evaluate a novel passive thermal regulation technique for a PV module using an extended surface area called "truncated fins". Enhanced solar irradiance intensity on the top surface of the PV module was achieved using a planner reflector with an optimum angle of 60°. The ANSYS, FLUENT software was employed to perform the computational fluid dynamics (CFD) analysis to predict the PV module temperature. To actively cool the PV module, a parametric study in terms of number, thickness, and height of fins was investigated. The distance between the fins also taken into consideration. Engineering equation solver (EES) software was also used to calculate the temperature of the bare PV module i.e., without cooling system. Meanwhile, Response Surface Method is used to determine the optimum number, height, and thickness of fins. The novel passive cooling method showed that the PV system temperature significantly dropped from 64.3 °C without cooling to 44.14 °C with cooling using truncated fins, with a temperature difference of approximately 20.16 °C in comparison to the bare PV module. Additionally, the PV electrical efficiency with truncated fins improved by 9.2% under natural convection.

Author Keywords: Design of expert/ response surface method

articleTitle: Effect of Nonlinear Power Amplifier on 32- QAM Performance Using Different Communication Channels
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: High power amplifier (HPA) is one of the utmost nonlinear element in radio communication system . It used to improvement a signal to power level to be suitable for transmission over the communication channel . But in equally the amplifier distort the signals that pass through it.The effect simulation o of power amplifier nonlinearity on 32 – Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (32 – QAM) is demonstrated in this work using Matlab/Simulink. Also It can use the constellation diagram to show the nonlinearity distressing on diagram of the 32-QAM modulation and bit error rate (BER) parameter are used as performance measure.

articleTitle: The optimum location of capacitor to improve the voltage of 220/66 kV Substation Using ETAP Software
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The power system planning, design and operation study require load flow analysis to know the now day loads and generation also plan for future load demand in the network. Moreover, to know the voltages at every bus to connect suitable devices that can support the voltage stability. In this paper the study has been done on real network of 220/66 kV substation (Houn substation, Libyan network). Electrical Transient Analyzer Program (ETAP), is used to model and analysis the network. The switchgears, transformers and lines in the substation had modeled to do the power flow analysis. The power flow analysis determine the buses that suffer from under voltage and that need reactive power injected to maintain system voltages within specified limits. The results showed that the optimum location of capacitors connection to the network could improve the system voltage.

articleTitle: Design of Wideband Metamaterial Absorber Using Multiple Ring Resonators For X-Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Electromagnetic waves absorption is required for many applications. Pyramidal absorbers are bulky and hence not suitable for many applications where compact planar structures are required. Metamaterial absorbers has such geometry but with the drawback of being narrow in bandwidth. In this paper an idea for extending the bandwidth of a metamaterial ring absorber is introduced. The bandwidth extension is obtained by using multiple rings each with a slightly different resonance frequency to produce an overall wide band of about 1.4GHz extending from 9.3 to 10.7GHz making it useful for X-band applications. The simulation results performed with HFSS show obeying this objective with an absorbitivity of more than 85% for the entire band.

articleTitle: Massive MIMO: On which Side Should It Be to Achieve the Highest Capacity?
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper revisits the problem of assessing the different antenna configurations of the massive MIMO from the system capacity point of view. Specifically, it tried to answer the question: On which side should we deploy the larger number of antennas to achieve the highest possible capacity of the system?. Thus, it investigated the effect of increasing the number of antennas of every side of a massive MIMO system, while keeping the other side equipped with a smaller number of antennas. According to the observations of this paper, it is clear that deploying more antennas on the receiving side will allow for higher system capacity compared with the case of using the same number of antennas at the transmitting side.

articleTitle: Decision Tree Algorithms for Predictive Modeling in Breast Cancer Treatment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Successful treatment of breast cancer increases a high chance of survival among women. Machine Learning could support the discovery of knowledge and important patterns from medical data by a good predictive model. The study aims to identify the effective and predictive modeling for the primary treatment of breast cancer after diagnosis. The data-set was collected from patients records who have malignant from the Benghazi Medical Center. Decision Tree algorithms J48, CART, and Random Forest were used to build three models by WEKA software. The data-set was divided into two subsets training and testing. Accuracy of Prediction, Sensitivity test, Specificity test, Area under curve, Kappa statistics, and Mean Absolute Error was used to compare models’ performance. The study results showed that the Random Forest was the better model for "training data" and "test data" compared to J48 and CART models. Also, the Random Forest model could provide good information and is able to recognize the important patterns. This study concluded that the Random Forest might a good model for detecting breast cancer treatment.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Estimate the Structure Design Complication of Multi-Agents Based Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Making a design decision in architecture design (AD) is challenging, especially when the system has many components and interactions. The complication is evident in the design phase of agents-based systems that are assigned various responsibilities, according to most works of literature. The study's purpose is to assist system designers in developing effective architectures for agents systems that are not complicated and easy to understand. Complex Task Measurement is a novel estimation of entanglement between agents' tasks presented in this paper (CTM). This method is built on the use-case point perspective, however with several adjustments to meet the demands of agents. Before making a design decision, this innovative measurement can be utilized to estimate the architecture design. The findings will be put to use in a variety of situations. As a case study, the research will be applied to the book recommendations system, and the results will be presented after the method has been implemented.

articleTitle: Microgrid For Saving Critical Loads
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In power system, the existence of distributed energy resources (DERs) is increasing, which in turn led to the attention of microgrid (MG). As the MG is the promising future of the smart grid (SG), it can be used when the main grid is unavailable in order to feed critical loads or in countryside areas, particularly in faraway unreachable areas. In this paper, we design a MG model using Matlab/Simulink to restore service to critical loads when the main grid feeding is cutting off under any circumstance. The simulation results showed how the control in MG operation modes can save critical loads.

articleTitle: Studying of an Adaptive Unscented Kalman Filter as a Target Tracking Algorithm with Matlab Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The radar is considered as one of tracking application which we need to tracking unknown targets. This application is using a kalman filter. Also the extended and unscented kalman filter has been created to deal with nonlinear systems such as multidimensional radar tracking. If wideband radar is used, multiple return signals may be obtained by scattering on a single target in a single pulse. It is important to monitor multiple dispersions on an undefined number of artifacts in the specific problem considered, with a standard wideband radar model, whose motion involves a nonlinear rotational velocity component. The measurements used are scattered range, range-rate (in analogy to Doppler), nonlinear functions of the scattered position and velocity, with parameters in the state-space model. In order to evaluate the scene and observe its progression over time, the tracker design uses a Kalman Filter type to model the nonlinear dynamics and measurement items and a multi-pronged association scheme.

articleTitle: Investigation and Simulation the Effect of Nonlinear Amplifier on 16- PAM Modulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In fact that most power consumption block in high speed wireless communication systems is caused by ingrained nonlinear nature of power amplifiers which effect the transmitted signal. This article introduce the nonlinear power amplifier simulation effect on pulse amplitude modulation (16-PAM) transmitted signal and how it effect the system performance, such a degradation of the Bit Error Rate (BER), an Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) channel are used in simulation model, in order to isolate the impacts in Solid Stat power Amplifier by using Matlab/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Reduction the Reflection Losses in Solar Cells by Analysis of Mixed and Different Nano-Grating Shapes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this paper, the solar cell is an electronic device which directly converts sunlight into electricity. Solar cells should have maximum efficiency to effectively collect most of the available sunlight. In this paper, finite-difference time domain (FDTD) process is utilized to simulate the reflection losses of mixed and various schemes of nano-grating shapes for solar cells. This paper presented the simulation results of mixed and no-grating shapes different schemes are discussed the reflection losses. Simulation results illustration that the reflectance loss for a trapezoidal cone or perfect cone-shaped nano-lattice construction with a grating height of ~250 nm and a period of 830 nm is ~1%, that is, ~29% which is less than that of flat type substrates and the reflection losses of the mixed micro-reticular forms a triangular- and trapezoidal-shaped (perfectly conical or conical) nano-reticular structure having a grating height of 250 nm and a period of 830 nm about 2% which is about 28% lower than other smooth stripe substrates.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Catching the Flux Leakage in Induction Machines Using Wireless Power Transfer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this paper, a guide for the design and construction of a receiver coil to catch the power losses caused by the flux leakage of an induction motor has been presented. The characterization methods for the wireless power received are also provided. In this work we derived the proper relation between induction motor windings and receiver coil to receive the maximum power possible. The equivalent circuit of the proposed system is introduced along with the circuit theory to analyze the system. The design and characterization method for the receiver are provided. For effective wireless power receive, the proposed system need to be set at 50Hz. Two receivers with multiple circular winding are constructed. One placed at the front of the motor coils and the other is placed at the back of the same motor coils. Using these types of receivers at both sides of the inductive motor, a purely free wireless power transfer of about watts is achieved.

articleTitle: Detection of three-phase induction motor faults using deep network-based transfer learning techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: As the induction motors in the industry operate in difficult and confined environments, condition monitoring the condition of the motor is crucial to avoid production loss. A new hybrid application that uses a pre-trained model-based ImageNet weight is proposed for fault diagnosis using the induction motor thermal images. A deep transfer learning network based on the Efficient Net-B0 model is developed as a feature extractor. As the use of pre-trained model architecture does not need a manual attribute extraction, the classification performance and decrease in computational complexity can be improved without a noticeable assignment. The methodology of this work includes two stages: the first one consists of the use of deep learning algorithms for feature extraction. Secondly, the classification assessment of the induction motor faults is considered to validate the system's performance. The model performance has been examined by applying thermal images of the induction motor. The achieved results have precisely proved the superiority and robustness of the combination of these techniques based on pre-trained weight and learning algorithms to extract the most appropriate features to build an effective classification system for induction motor fault diagnosis topic. The proposed model has achieved the highest accuracy of 91.9% by applying an Efficient Net-B0 network.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of High Gain 2×2 MIMO Microstrip Antenna Operating at 28 GHz
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this paper, four configurations of 2×2 MIMO microstrip antenna operating at 28 GHz are proposed and simulated by Computer Simulation Technology (CST) software. The antenna is designed on PTFE/Teflon substrate with dielectric constant of 2.1, loss tangent of 0.0002, and thickness of 1.58 mm. The performance of all proposed configurations of 2×2 MIMO antennas are evaluated based on the overall gain, envelope correlation coefficient (ECC), and diversity gain (DG). Moreover, the comparison between all cases in this work is done in order to choose the optimal configuration, and to prove the reliability of the design the best obtained case is compared with proposed antennas in published works.

articleTitle: Design of a Vivaldi antenna using particle swarm optimization for 5G applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Wideband compact size antennas are needed for many civil and military applications. Vivaldi antennas can obey these requirements with a moderate gain. In this paper, a wideband Vivaldi antenna is designed to cover the band 15 to 40GHz suitable for 5G applications. Particle swarm optimization technique is used to meet the requirements of gain and matching over this band. The optimized design is then further improved to reduce the side lobes by corrugating the antenna outer boundaries. The design shows a good performance over most of the band with a gain of more than 10dB and return loss less than -10dB except for a small portion of the band.

articleTitle: High Driven Sub-harmonically Up-conversion Mixers based Schottky Diodes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The paper explores the anticipated performance of up-conversion mixers based Schottky diodes exploiting the 2nd harmonic of a pumped local oscillator signal. Prior to fabrication, advanced design system (Agilent ADS) is employed to optimize two designs based microstrip technology via a quartz substrate of 50μm thickness. The conversion efficiencies and the output powers are investigated for two different operating frequencies. The first sub-harmonic mixer intended at 110 GHz providing a single-sideband (SSB) conversion loss better than 9dB and output power greater than 1dBm at the input one-dB compression point of 10dBm, while the second up-converter functions at 290GHz exhibiting a decent SSB conversion loss of 5dB and output power of -8dBm at a 3dBm of the one-dB point. The two up-converters, 110GHz and 290GHz, attain good conversion efficiencies leading to maximum output powers of 7dBm and -3.5dBm, respectively. The key aim was to evaluate high pumped up-conversion mixers, as direct output power up-converters, since power amplifiers are economically inaccessible or unattractive. To benchmark the design results, a comparison to other reported works is introduced, where the current designs demonstrate attractive performances.

articleTitle: Classification of the Libyan International Internet Traffic using Deep Packet Inspection Tools
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Network Traffic Classification is very essential for Internet service providers (ISPs) and helping them in defining and adapting the priorities. A lot of decisions and actions are taken depending on the traffic classification. That is for both commercial and technical issues. In this paper, different approaches were developed to classify the internet traffic data from different point of views, namely, Traffic Types, URL Categories and Visited websites. The classification was done for each of these types depending on traffic amount and the number of accessing counts.These approaches were applied on a data collected and obtained from the Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) tool installed in the Libyan International Telecom Company (LITC) network, which is representing the only international gateway to Libya through different ports. In order to reduce the international traffic, LITC installed cache servers on its network four years ago. The used data in this work were taken before and after installing these cache servers, to show the changed happened to the network and how cache severs affecting the amount and the nature of the international traffic.The result shows that a large portion of the internet data passing through the Libya gateways is for social network, streaming and search engines, especially for Facebook, YouTube, and Google websites. And the impact of installing cache servers was dominant in these categories.

articleTitle: Finger Knukle Print Recognition based on the Combination of the Multi Shift Local Binary Pattern Descriptor with Discrete Fourier Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The old security systems used have proven to be not very efficient as they are easy for hackers to obtain. The most crucial component of computer systems is user safety. The use of biometrics is more secure in identifying identity. There has been more interest in Finger Knuckle Print (FKP) as a feature of biometrics. The reason was due to the high efficiency and accuracy that this measurable feature implied. This paper presents a blending approach that combines information from two algorithms, Multi shift Local binary patterns (MSLBP) and Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) method, to create a new vector of FKP. In the classification process, Support Vector Machine (SVM) was used. The PolyU FKP database was used in the experiments. The outcomes of the evaluation shows that the proposed approach improves the performance of FKP compared with a number of existing approaches.

articleTitle: Investigation and Study of the Performance of a DVB Over Satellite Link Using M-ary PSK
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this paper, the performance of a Digital Video Broadcasting Over Satellite Link, a digital Video second-generation for satellite broadcasting (DVB-S2), was investigated and studied as a case study. The simulation was done by using Matlab in order to evaluate DVB-S2 performance developments in channel coding (LDPC codes) combined with modulation schemes (QPSK and 8-PSK ), code rates, forward error correction (FEC) and transmission channels. The obtained simulation results were graphically presented, where the bit error rate as a function of the signal to noise ratio (S/N) was evaluated as well.

articleTitle: Improving Use Case Points Techniques to Support Size Estimation of Software Projects
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: There are many different ways to size estimate of software projects. However, software developers always have problems in choosing the right method for their projects. The Use Case Points (UCP) is among these common methods, but there is still some complexity in using them in a way that greatly contributes to obtaining accurate estimates. This paper presents an improvement of the UCP method, whereby an activity diagram is used and adapted and a weighting mechanism is developed. The improved method “Merging use case points (M-UCP)” will contribute to reducing the complexity of the traditional UCP method in the estimation process. In addition, a case study is introduced to test the refined method, and the results showed that the method performed better in comparison with previous methods in size estimating software development.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison Study of Solid Oxide Fuel Cell With Direct Oxidation in Three Fuel Types
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) can be fed with several types of fuel, including hydrogen gas, carbon monoxide and methane, which are direct oxidation fuels within the cell. In this paper, models of thermochemical and thermoelectric processes were designed and calculated for three types of fuels by using C++ program, The results indicated the thermal behavior and electrical output of the fuel cell according to the temperature change over its operation period. This study showed that the maximum and minimum values for cell outputs such as reversible voltage, electrical work, heat generated and cell efficiency. The behavior of changing these outputs with the increasing operating temperature was compared for each chemical reaction of three direct oxidation fuels.

articleTitle: Invetigate the Effect of Connecting Multiple FACTS Controller on Voltage Stability and Power Transfer Capabilities
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Due to the increase in demand of electricity nowadays, a remarkable shift in electricity generation was observed in recent years to increase power system transfer capabilities to meet the increased demand, many solutions have been introduced, comes in front the Flexible AC Transmission system (FACTs), which can provide extra pliability to enhance power transfer capabilities. Thyristor Controlled Series Compensator (TCSC) and the Unified Power Flow Controller (UPFC) are among the FACTs family. Former one is the Static Synchronous Series Compensator (SSSC), which is connected in series, and the latter is called STATic COMpensator (STATCOM), which is in parallel connection, is both together can have an important role in power transfer capabilities and voltage stability. In this paper, a comparison study between TCSC and UPFC controllers is introduced. The IEEE 14-bus system is modeled and simulated using the NEPLAN Program. The results show amelioration in the test system bus voltages and real power transfer with a noticeable losses reduction.

articleTitle: Study of a Meteorological Conditioning for Solar-Driven Ejector Refrigeration Systems: Efficiency Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Suffering from greenhouse gas pollutions and demand of energy due to crude oil vanish lead to enforce worldwide to look out at alternative Energy sources. In theory assumption are made when optimizing Modeling process, however in practice these assumptions can distort the output response thereby affecting precision and accuracy as a case study in refrigeration system for solar-driven ejector to determine the quality of the energy in the system by change high temperatures sources under the steady state, steady flow conditions. The energy system quality differs on the operation environments, ejector geometry and the choice of working fluid (refrigerant).The study carries out on the refrigeration system with solar-driven ejector (RSSE) using R141b, for an administration building application HVAC system in Tripoli, Libya. The reported hourly outdoor temperature and solar radiation are used for the analysis of the system performance.The optimum parameters were employed to generate a model and predict the behavior of the system at different parameter condition. Using the optimum operating condition, an output of calculations show that through the work times from 6:00 to 18:00, the typical Coefficient Of Performance and the typical solar segment of the usage were 0. 3 and 0.715 in that order as the working environments are: high temperature source (90 °C), evaporative temperature (8 °C), low sink temperature (32 °C).

articleTitle: Channel Polarization Analysis Using BEC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This work deals with a phenomenon called channel polarization, There is a fact that says that it is possible to connect N group of identical independent channels B-DMC W of capacity I(W) in a certain way to obtain a second group so that the specifications of the identical channels change to others with different capacities. Some of them increase their capacity to reach one I(W)≅1, and the other particles decrease their capacity to reach zero I(W) ≅ 0, and this is called channel polarization, which has an impact on the coding process (channel coding). To ensure the reliability of the transmission, we send information only on good channels with high capacity and we freeze others with low capacity. In this work, we study the effect of channel polarization on BEC (binary erasure channel) and we get good results.

articleTitle: Mobile Edge Computing Issues and Proposed Solution
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Due to the rapid growth of Internet-based services, the access to these services has quickly become one of the most critical goals. Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) allows content providers, application developers, and information technology services to be performed at the mobile network’s edges, rather than at the network’s core. This paper demonstrates how to take use of MEC technology and provide excellent performance to public networks in data cache. As a result, response time (latency) will be reduced significantly, network bandwidth will be enhanced, and Quality of Experience (QoE) of end user will improve.

articleTitle: Power Quality Improvement in Grid Connected PV System using Fuzzy Logic Controller based Maximum Power Point Tracing(MPPT)
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The expansion of the spread of solar photovoltaic power generation systems is fraught with challenges related to the low efficiency and performance of these systems in light of the change in the surrounding weather conditions and the disturbances associated with the loads, which weakens the electrical energy productivity of these photovoltaic systems due to energy loss. To overcome and reduce these challenges as much as possible, it is considered the use of controllers that track the maximum power point of photovoltaic systems is the ideal solution to increase their efficiency and improve the quality of their electrical power, in order to obtain the maximum productive capacity from these systems, and this will be reflected in achieving an optimum benefit from the available solar energy and thus reducing the loss of unused energy in the absence of the control system.This paper presents a study, analysis and simulation of the actual behaviour of the grid-connected solar photovoltaic system model by means of the (MATLAB/Simulink_R2018a) program. The performance of Fuzzy Logic Controller is then evaluated to track the path of the maximum power point, and its work is based on tracking techniques that use the direct control method to control the operating cycle of the DC commutator, which in turn performs by feeding the inverter with the maximum output power from the solar photovoltaic system.A tracking technology was selected that relies on the method of artificial intelligence, which is the technique (fuzzy logic controller), and a fuzzy logic controller of the type (Mamdani) was used. The most suitable for tracking the maximum power point at the steady state of the Grid and under constant and changing weather conditions, as well as choosing the most appropriate controller when transient disturbances occur in the Grid under constant weather conditions only. The results proved the effectiveness of the fuzzy logic controller, and it had good performance in tracking the maximum power point in terms of achieving more stability, reducing error and settling time.

articleTitle: Enhancing the FSO link range under very clear air and thin fog conditions in Albayda - Libya
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Free space optical (FSO) communications are an effective technology that is characterized by its high signal bandwidth and low transmission power. Although, this technology uses the free space as a communication channel, atmospheric attenuation in particular fog limits its design with long link range. In this paper, the attenuation due to fog was estimated for the Albayda - Libya by using Kim model, and Optisystem software was used for increase FSO link range under very clear air and thin fog conditions using MIMO technology and pre located EDFA, where the FSO link range increased from 14.9 km to 109.9 km at the very clear air condition and from 6.3 km to 17.7 km at thin fog condition.

articleTitle: Comparison between harmonic identification techniques of active filter with experimental validation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The frequent use of certain so-called nonlinear loads poses a serious problem for the electricity network; because they draw from the electrical network a distorted current (not sinusoidal). Given this constraint, the objective is then to eliminate the harmonic currents present in the network. Therefore, the active filtering method was chosen, more precisely the use of the parallel active filter (PAF) which has many more advantages. So to have good harmonic compensation, the parallel active filter will require an adequate and robust control system. For this, a comparative study was carried out with the implementation of the different control strategies, namely the instantaneous power PQ method, the instantaneous current DQ method and the direct power control DPC method. Finally, a real-time implementation was developed experimentally using a control card of the DSPACE 1104 to approved and validate the functionality of the FA with DPC method.

articleTitle: Distributed Nonlinear State Estimation using SDRE Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this paper two sequential distributed nonlinear estimators are proposed to estimate all subsystems states of a nonlinear large scale system. These estimation methods are based on the State-Dependent--Riccati-Equation (SDRE) Kalman filter. The power plant system considered in this work is naturally distributed systems and has various subsystems that can communicate with each other through a communication network. The objective is to implement a distributed state estimation method for the interconnected subsystems in order to reduce the computation effort required in the centralized estimation scheme. Simulation results show that the performance of the suggested distributed nonlinear estimator is close to the centralized nonlinear estimator, but it is computationally much more efficient.

articleTitle: Efficient Real-Time Executive for ARM-Based Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Real-time computer systems are significant today, because they govern a broad range of applications, from simple laboratory testing to complex flight control systems. In real-time computing systems, the system's correctness is achieved not only by the logical conclusion, but also by the time at which deadlines are met. This paper introduces a real-time executive (RTX) that implements the essential requirements of real-time operating system including a leak-free memory management, priority-based scheduling ensuring efficient utilization of CPU time while maintaining priority for critical tasks, inter-process communication allowing cooperative processing, serial communication with the user allowing for user interaction and monitoring of the system.The RTX is implemented on two ARM-based microcontrollers (STM32F303RE and STM32F401 RE). The significance of this RTX is that it provides a practical infrastructure and utilizes the capabilities of ARM architecture, considering that ARM processors are widely used in everyday embedded systems.The efficacy of the RTX is verified via experimental work. The RTX is exposed to various stress tests to observe the impact on meeting deadlines in real-time.

articleTitle: Propagation Channel Modeling Utilizing Discrimination Analysis for Outdoor Environments
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In a wireless communication network, the performance and QoS of the network mainly depend on the propagation model of the channel. However, most empirical propagation models for outdoor environments don’t estimate the propagation of radio signals properly. This study proposes a novel technique based on machine learning to predict channel propagation in outdoor environments. The Linear Discriminate Analysis (LDA) method is proposed to estimate the path loss measurements in an urban and suburban environment, the proposed model considers; the geo-location of the receiver antenna, line-of-sight, and non-LOS propagation scenarios. In terms of accuracy, the results show that when using the LDA-based model to predict the pathloss measurements, results are better than traditional theoretical and analytical models.

articleTitle: Investigation and a review of the solar installations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This work consists of studying the types of existing photovoltaic installations, those connected to the grid and those not connected to the grid, better known as on-grid and off-grid installations. The study will be done at the level of the equipment, the production of energy specific to the installation and the metrological forecasts of the chosen area and the technical and economic balance sheet of the two installations, we will also touch on the different aspects and basic stages of the sizing of these installations in order to better distinguish the various components of these systems..At the end we will give a general conclusion which will touch on a comparison between the advantages and disadvantages of the two types of installation.

articleTitle: Developing Novel SOFC Electrolyte for Advanced Clean Energy Generation during the Pandemic (COVID-19)
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Recently, the whole world has been shocked by the spread of Coronavirus (COVID-19), and all health workers struggled to provide all possible services to save a single life. Although, there is no place for patients to stay in the hospital. So, to keep the appropriate treatment procedure for infected people and save their lives, there is an essential need for a continuous power system. That needs to be overcome by a stable energy source like solid oxide fuel cells (SOFCs). Therefore, this paper attempted to produce new energy materials (SOFC electrolyte) from Sm<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> dopant and evaluates the production steps of SOFC electrolytes in a morphological method by Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscope (FESEM). The second aim involves the synthesis of new electrolytes and electrically estimated by an electrochemical (EIS) instrument. By these goals, the present experimental work attempts to conquer the decisive current pandemic to ensure a continuous electrical powder by producing new electrolyte materials to be employed in fuel cell applications.

articleTitle: Vehicle Coverage Range and Vehicle Traffic Density effect on Contention level over VANET in Highway using OLSR Routing Protocol
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper studies vehicle coverage range/ traffic density influence on contention level over vehicle ad-hoc network in highway using optimized link state routing protocol to see its ability to route traffic data and connect vehicles. Contention level generally shows the ability to share assigned bandwidth between nodes and give a clue of bottlenecks that might occur during carrying traffic. Contention level is a key performance indicator that measures the performance of vehicle ad-hoc network under the effect of vehicle coverage range that each vehicle covers at which data can be transmitted and/or received to/from other vehicles or nodes during its movement along the highway, and vehicle traffic density as well. In this study, data is routed using optimized link state routing protocol which control sending data using multiple chosen nodes as relays to connect vehicles in the network.

articleTitle: Iris recognition system based on fuzzy local binary pattern histogram and multiple classifiers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The local binary pattern (LBP) histogram is known as a potent and attractive texture descriptor that shows brilliant results. A number of new extensions to LBP-based texture descriptors have been proposed that focus on noise intensity enhancement. In iris recognition system, one of the main challenges is to improve the robustness of image brightness and noise changes by using different coding or thresholding schemes. This paper proposes the fuzzy local binary pattern (FLBP) approach to extract iris features at the early recognition stage. FLBP has several advantages including ease of execution and robustness under changing image conditions. The proposed system provided a significant improvement in recognition performance as it has the benefit of the strength of the histogram that provides the great majority of local context information. The proposed iris detection design uses support vector machine (SVM), linear discriminant analysis (LDA), and k-nearest neighbor (KNN) classifier for classification. Experiments with two challenging iris databases (CASIA-VI and CASIA-V4) were performed to determine the usefulness of the approaches. The method has been evaluated against existing techniques and the proposed approaches have produced excellent results.

articleTitle: Impact of Thermal Noise on Communication System Performance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Thermal noise is always present in the electronic circuits due to the vibration of charge carriers within circuits conductors that is directly proportional to the device temperature. In most cases preventing thermal noise is impossible, it is very important to evaluate the impact of this type of noise on the performance of communication systems and main parameters such as bit error rate (BER). The evaluation will help to properly design the communication transmission and receiving systems by evaluation the contribution of the total power noise produced by thermal noise. In practice this noise effect can be reduced by reducing the temperature of operation or reducing the electrical circuits resistance value of the devices as thermal noise is generated by the real part impedance only of the electronic components.The thermal noise is proportional to the temperature and frequency bandwidth, but the Impact of this noise on the overall performance of the system is varying depending on the system design, communication channel, modulation, the levels of signal to noise ratio (SNR) and BER.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic Controlled Voltage Transfer Ratio of a Matrix Converter under Harmonic Distortion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: the supply of loads by static converters in order to ensure operation at variable voltage and frequency are widely used today. However, these command structures differ mainly by the type of static converter and the command strategy used. Furthermore, the performance of such conversion structures depends mainly on the operating conditions at the time. the main object of this study is the application of fuzzy logic controller with Space Vector Modulation strategy for matrix converter under disturbed input voltage. The control strategy of voltage transfer ratio of the matrix converter using fuzzy logic. The simulation results obtained at the end of this work show that the proposed system is valid, efficient and effective.

articleTitle: Development of an Evolutionary Cost Sensitive Decision Tree Induction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper develops an Evolutionary Elliptical Cost-Sensitive Decision Tree Algorithm (EECSDT) which learns cost-sensitive non-linear decision trees for multiclass problems. EECSDT is developed by formulating the problem as an optimization task in which the objective is to minimize classification cost and where elliptical decision boundaries are adopted instead of axis parallel boundaries. EECSDT is implemented using MOEA, a framework for multi-objective evolutionary algorithms, and evaluated on fourteen data sets. An empirical evaluation with J48, NBTree, MetaCost, and the CostSensitiveClassifier in Weka shows that EECSDT performs better on 11 out of the 14 data sets in terms of accuracy, and 10 out of the 14 data sets in terms of minimizing cost. It also produces smaller trees on 8 out of the 11 datasets for which it achieves higher accuracy than use of axis parallel boundaries.

articleTitle: Multiband Option and Size Reduction of PIFA antenna by using Genetic Algorithm and Gridded Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Because of the increasing evolution of wireless communication systems, there is a high request for novel Miniature multi-band antennas that may be incorporated with other electrical components in the same device. A new small PIFA antenna (planar inverted F antenna) is enhanced using a binary genetic method in this paper. An antenna with many bands is used instead of a single band antenna, the top patch geometry is optimized using a genetic algorithm to achieve multi-band options. The developed antenna is a triple-band antenna and has three resonant frequencies at, 2.69 GHz, 3.89 GHz, and 5.89 GHz with a bandwidth of, 400 MHz, 200 MHz, and 350 MHz respectively. The PIFA antenna can cover LTE2600, WiMAX, and WLAN applications.

articleTitle: Theoretical and Practical Study on Attenuation in Optical Fibers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this paper, we will get acquainted with the components of the optical fiber communication system and the definition of the optical fiber and its study in terms of its internal structure and knowledge of its types, uses, advantages and disadvantages. Optical fibers and we will talk about attenuation in optical fibers and then we will include theories and basics of optical fibers and then we will dedicate a special chapter to the study of networks that use optical fiber communication technology in Libya. In particular, long-range networks, whether terrestrial networks or marine networks in terms of their size, uses, technology in which they operate and where they are located, and using the laboratory model (kl-95001), we will study a practical study on the loss in the value of the output voltage of the signal transmitted through the optical fiber by studying the relationship between the length of the optical fiber The optical fiber, the distance between the optical fiber and the light source, and the value of the output voltage.

articleTitle: Using Power Flow Control Technology to Increase the Capability and flexibility of the Existing Electrical Transmission System of Libya
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Because of big growth into the electricity demand, and the difficulty that face power transmission sector of Libya to repair or expansion its existing transmission system, the transmission lines are more likely to be overloaded. Adding new transmission lines can be avoided or postponed if quick and appropriate technologies of controlling active and reactive power are made accessible. There are several types of Flexible AC Ttransmission System (FACTS) devices that can assist achieving these targets. Examples of these devices are the Unified Power Flow Controller (UPFC), Phase Shifting Transformer (PST), and Thyristor Controlled Series Capacitor (TCSC). The performance of these devices to control the power flow is investigated by using NEPLAN software and the results shows that these devices can help to control the power flow via the power transmission system. Consequently, the building of new transmission can be avoided or postponed.

articleTitle: A Proposed Research Methodology to Improve the Effectiveness of Information Technology Projects
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In the information technology discipline, a graduation project is normally a compulsory task in order to fulfill the university graduation requirements. The project is usually completed within one or two semesters; therefore, represents a real challenge for many students as the time is limited, furthermore it expected that the students have not collected yet adequate research experience. They lack a defined plan regarding project phases and the activities involved during their research. This paper proposes a new methodology named IMGSIE which stands for Introduction, Method, Generalization, Specification, Implementation, and evaluation. It functions as a research lifecycle for structuring and organizing graduation projects. This methodology is already used, and three different questionnaires have been distributed to supervisors and students, the feedback was highly satisfactory, and positive towards the effectiveness of all students who used the methodology.

articleTitle: Dynamic Behaviour of Induction Generator Connected to Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The wind turbines connected to distribution networks, is one of the renewable energy type that is a clean and available from the nature. Although the use of wind turbines provides many benefits it also imposes various challenges with regards to stability, control and protection. In particular, this paper concentrates on assessing the dynamic behaviour of induction generator connected to wind turbines in the event of faults. These wind turbines are connected to Tobruk steam power station in Libya. The dynamic performance of induction generator is identified and thoroughly explained using case studies implemented in PSCAD/EMTDC. These case studies also provide insight and understanding into the impact that faults have on the operation of both the wind farm and the network. The results show the stability of induction generator related to critical clearing slip which is different to synchronous generator that related to critical angle. Moreover, Mathematical calculations have been done and compared with the simulation results

articleTitle: Decision Support System: Analysis And Design Methodology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The success of any organization depends on the quality of the decisions made, and good decisions can be made by analyzing all the available data and knowledge of the organization. Decision Support Systems (DSSs) are used to analyze this data and aid in decision-making in the formulation of well-studied decisions based on knowledge. However, the analysis and design of decision support systems (DSS) is a complex process that involves the use of appropriate methodologies, methods, and tools to model decision-making processes. This paper presents an architectural design of DSS framework. The proposed approach helps developers develop decision-making systems through models that detail the analysis and design.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of damping performance for viscoelastic material as the core of three layers laminated plate
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Viscoelastic materials are used in vibration damping applications as they have the ability to dissipate energy, they are used in machine basis, bridges and many other applications. In this paper four plates with the same thickness but different material lamination are investigated for their modal properties. Namely,natural frequencies, mode shapes and damping loss factors. Experimental modal analysis is carried out using impact hammer for excitation and accelerometer for measurement. Data is processed using computer package to obtain frequency response function (FRF) for each plate and modal parameters are extracted from the plot. Results are compared to finite element model that was created using ANSYS package. It showed very well agreement between experimental and finite element. Damping effect on the shift in natural frequencies was obvious due to the viscoelastic material thickness in the laminated plates. It is concluded that the finite element analysis using ANSYS software is a powerful tool in predicting natural frequencies and mode shapes even in laminated plates with viscoelastic core, it is also confirmed the effect of damping increase due to the use of viscelastic cores on the plate natural modes and vibration behaviour.

articleTitle: Enhancing Time Consuming Computation of Probabilistic Available Transfer Capability with Wind Resources using Probabilistic Collocation Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The majority of electrical energy consumption around the world use to be supplied by conventional resources, and local green worries to more clean resources, likewise wind or solar. However, the Available Transfer Capability (ATC) computation integrated with wind power sources with conventional power systems has been highly considered. The fluctuation characteristic of wind has contributed for generating several uncertainties to bulk operation, inform of random generation speed, unexpected generators outage, as well as lines, load achievement and vast on-line computation. Traditionally, to have a sufficiently secure operational margin, a transfer limit is calculated based on iterative simulations using the worst case scenario. This paper intends Probabilistic Collocation Method (PCM) for Available Transfer Capability computations through a penetration of wind energy sources. IEEE 5, 30 bus test system has been employed. The results of the proposed method analyzed compared with the conventional Deterministic Load Flow (DLF) approach as well as the probabilistic Monte Carlo Simulation (MCS) method.

articleTitle: Single-Ended Voltage Controlled Ring Oscillators Comparisons in 65nm Process
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Many designs for single-ended voltage-controlled ring oscillators that appeared in the literature are implemented in different process technologies. Most of these circuit topologies constructed with current starved inverters. In this paper, we have selected popular designs and implemented them in 65 nm PTM process, publicly available [1]. This allows us to generate fair performance and silicon area comparisons. The results shows that design II gave the best results (7.6GHz, 108 μW, FoM=-229 dBc/Hz).

articleTitle: Analysis the Effect of Fault Types on the Operation of Distance Relay including FACTs Controller for a part of Libyan Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: An electric power system faults is a situation that can be the basis of power system equipment failures such as transformers, generators, bus bars, etc. lads to abnormal operation of the power system network. In this paper, the effect of the most common faults on the operation of the distance protection system in the presence of selected types of FACTs controllers (STATCOM and UPFC) on a part of the Libyan network (southern Libyan) was studied. And to complete this, the Neplan program approved by the Libyan Electricity Company was used, and it was reached The results are discussed , simulation results show that the STATCOM and UPFC are able to enhance overall power system stability and capability, better power flow control, has a good impact on economic and environmental problems.

articleTitle: An Efficient Hybrid Pilot design for Channel Estimation in Massive MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In wireless communication systems, the pilot sequences have a significant impact on system performance, in particular, the channel estimation (CE) process. Thereby, this work addresses the CE process in fifth generation (5G) wireless communication systems (i.e., in Massive multiple-input and multiple-output systems) using different pilot designs (i.e., regular pilots (RPs), superimposed pilots (SuPs), and proposed hybrid pilots). In this work, we propose an efficient hybrid pilot design that combines the best features of both pilots (i.e., superimposed and RPs), since users that use RPs at the cell-edge are strongly affected by pilot contamination, whereas users that use SuPs and are close to the BS are strongly influenced by the interference coming from transmitting data and pilot together. Therefore, the hybrid pilot design is proposed to overcome the drawback of both pilot designs. We provide numerical results to assert our theoretical expressions.

articleTitle: Development of Robotic 3D Printing System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In recent years, 3D printing or Additive Manufacturing, has been capturing the imagination of everyone from entrepreneurs to at-home hobbyists. This growing technology has brought the cost down several times, especially in prototyping and low volume products. Most of the 3-d printers available today use a printing head mounted on a 3-axis CNC machine. This architecture could be improved by replacing the CNC system with robotic arm. Robot arm will provide more flexibility to the printing process especially in complicated shapes. Robotic system will provide additional orientation axes to the printing process. In this paper, an experimental application of robotic 3d-priting system is presented. The system architecture, programming and experimental results are provided.

articleTitle: A Biologically Inspired Adaptive Model Theory For Humanoid Robot Arm Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Biological control systems (which deal with non-stiff-joint plants, as a human arm is) have evolved during millions of years and have become into an interesting paradigm to emulate in robotic controller construction. The cerebellum is known to be involved in control and learning of smooth coordinated movements. Furthermore, an accurate understanding of how this advance control engine works should have a strong impact in controlling biomorphic robots. We propose a decentralized motor learning model for the cerebellum, as well as an intelligent adaptive system based on historical physiological data. The humanoid model is used to create a hybrid force/position controller for a dual arm.

articleTitle: Assessment of Image Quality Parameters for Computed Tomography in Tripoli, Libya
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Computed tomography (CT) is a powerful imaging technique widely used. In Libya, the performed CT examinations are increasing, and the high doses associated with those CT examinations must be controlled. The aim of this study is to investigate the performance of several CT scanners image quality used in different medical clinics in Tripoli.Philips CT phantom (Serial Number: 4535-671-35962) was used to acquire images, under the same imaging parameters (120 kVp, 200 mAs, image size of (512 x 512) by implementing the IAEA standards for image quality control (QC). Images were obtained in the DICOM format from each CT.Results showed that there was no major difference in uniformity between the selected regions of interest ROIs in X and Y- directions within all obtained scans, with the coefficient of variation %CV varying between 0.330 and 0.528. The linearity test of all scans exhibited the same trend as it was provided by the phantom manual; the lowest mean pixel intensity value was 956.678 for polyethylene and the highest mean pixel intensity value was for Teflon 1945.347. The contrast C and CNR, between the water layer and Teflon was the highest value varied between 172.913 and 262.199, and the lowest value, varied between 0.844 to 19.015.

articleTitle: Green Machine Learning for Green Cloud Energy Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The efficiency of energy in cloud computing (CC) is one of the critical and vital parameters for large server-based networks due to CC consuming a great amount of energy and the dramatic energy consumption growth in the area of digital services. Focus on cloud computing energy consumption and efficiency is one of the key issues in a modern data center structure for operation costs reduction and fulfilling the green computing goals. Machine learning plays an important role to optimize the operation of cloud communication to enhance energy efficiency. This paper provides an overview and details of employing machine learning (ML) to propose energy efficiency solutions in the green cloud communication environment. The paper also presents a background and literature view. Moreover, we will discuss the ML proposals for green cloud resources management. Furthermore, deep Mind AI in the cloud, trends, and challenges in the cloud data center

articleTitle: Green Machine Learning Approach for QoS Improvement in Cellular Communications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Green cellular communications are becoming an important approach due to large-scale and complex radio networks. Due to the dynamic cellular network behaviors related to interference distribution, traffic bottlenecks, congestion points, and hotspots, there is a need to evaluate the dynamic processes in cellular systems in addition to ensuring spectrum availability. The delay, loss rate, and SNR are the most issues that may affect cellular communication performance. Artificial intelligent algorithms such as machine learning (ML) enable to detection of the dynamics in cellular networks by analyzing the complex cellular network processes and evaluating the spectrum and links qualities. It enables the extraction of spectrum knowledge from the network autonomously. The extracted information helps to know about every dynamic change in wireless parameters, related to frequency, modulation, route selection, etc. This paper provides details about the use of ML in green cellular networks to efficiently upgrade the communications and enhances different related approaches including quality of services (QoS), signal traffic load, and energy efficiency, which are critical issues of green cellular communication paradigms. The paper also presents the technical concept of green ML approaches to solve significant problems in cellular communications, in addition to future aspects and considerations for energy consumption minimization using the green ML approach in cellular radio communications.

articleTitle: Position Feedback Control of Lagrangian Robotic Systems via an Affine PD-Based Control Law. Part 1: Design of LMI Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Among the appropriate methods to describe the morphology of a robotic system, we note the development of a nonlinear dynamic model defined by the equations of the robot’s motion. Thus, the control design method can be based on the linearization of the nonlinear model. Therefore, in this work, we rely on the difference between the nonlinear model of Lagrangian robotic systems and the approximated linear dynamics to obtain a dynamical model that satisfies a certain Lipschitz condition. Thus, we introduce an affine PD-based control law in the obtained dynamic model to develop by three methods the stability conditions using the Schur complement, the Young inequality and the S-procedure lemma. These conditions are described by Linear Matrix Inequalities (LMIs). Finally, we present some results by adopting, as an illustrative example, the manipulator robot with two degrees of freedom, as a Lagrangian robotic system.

articleTitle: Investigating the Applicability of Horizontal to Tilted Sky-Diffuse Solar Irradiation Transposition Models for Key Libyan Cities
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The global solar irradiation incident on a tilted surface with different tilt angles is one of the most important requirements for simulating solar energy systems. However, such data is often not available. For this reason scientists, database platforms and commercial software resort to employ transposition models to convert horizontal solar irradiation into tilted solar irradiation incident on any inclined surface at any degree. The present study considered a wide range of the most commonly used horizontal to tilted transposition models around the world. In the absence of measured information, the horizontal solar radiation was obtained from Solargis for six locations in Libya, which were carefully selected to represent all Libyan territories. Three cities were selected in the north (Tripoli, Sirte and Benghazi), a city in the middle (Al-Jufra) and two cities in the south (Sabha and Kufra). The proposed approach was applied to these cities for selected 22 transposition models and for various tilt angles (10°-90°) in order to determine the best model for use in each area at any given tilt angle. According to the obtained results, it is recommended to use Bugler; 1988 model as the most accurate model for the northern and central regions of the country, and Lui&Jordan model; 1963 as the most applicable model for the southern region.
